name: Goldia Ricks
subject: Dr. Nila and why she's running.
body:
She is the proud daughter of immigrants from Bangladesh who made their home in Hampton Roads over forty years ago. Her mother’s work for the Navy with TRICARE and the military families around her taught Dr. Nila that strong communities are built by looking out for one another. That belief has guided her life’s work, from standing up for survivors of domestic violence as a lawyer at a legal aid clinic, to caring for veterans, families, and neighbors as a hospital physician. Every day, she sees the human cost of Washington’s failures, as patients skip care because they cannot afford it, families are forced to choose between medicine and paying their bills, and veterans wait months for care they urgently need. Dr. Nila is running for Congress to fix a broken health care system, bring down the cost of living, and make sure no one in Hampton Roads goes bankrupt just because they got sick. Dr. Nila wants to protect Virginia's second district from D.C.'s overreach, including the intrusion of ICE into the community and risking our service members' lives in an unauthorized and unnecessary war with Iran. She is fighting against dark money in politics including corporate PAC money and foreign interest money. Dr. Nila has spent her life fighting for people’s lives and is ready to do the same in Congress.

\--

Team Nila for Dr. Nila Devanath
Candidate for Congress, Virginia’s Second District

[nilaforcongress.com](http://nilaforcongress.com)

name: Cortese, Mike (Council Member)
subject: Data Center Legislation Update (06.11.26)
body:
I hope you're well.

I wanted to provide an update on the data center legislation currently before the Council. We were successful in advancing CM Johnston's late-filed legislation establishing a temporary moratorium on new data center development, and the bill passed on first reading. I am encouraged by this progress.

The moratorium would provide an additional layer of protection for our community while the Council considers CM Horton's comprehensive zoning legislation, which would establish Nashville's first framework governing the siting and operation of data centers. Given the complexity of this issue and the likelihood of robust public discussion and potential amendments, the moratorium helps ensure that development does not outpace the policy process.

I strongly support both pieces of legislation and am currently working with Metro Legal and other stakeholders to explore additional safeguards that could be incorporated through friendly amendments as the conversation moves forward.

One important note: the proposed moratorium would not affect the data center project adjacent to the Nashville Zoo. Because the project does not require a zoning change and permits have already been submitted, those applications are generally evaluated under the regulations in effect at the time they were filed. I have asked both Metro Legal and Codes Legal to continue researching whether there are any additional legal avenues available to address concerns related to this project.

In the meantime, public engagement remains one of the most important tools available to us. I encourage you to continue making your voice heard and sharing your concerns with decision-makers. I will continue pursuing every available option and will keep the community informed as we learn more.

Thank you for your engagement on this issue.
Mike Cortese | Metro Councilman, District 4
Metropolitan Government of Nashville & Davidson County
Non-Emergency Services: Hub.Nashville.gov<https://hub.nashville.gov/s/?language=en_US> or Dial: 311
Council Office: (615) 862-6780 | Personal Cell: (615) 200-7980

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2467%2E135344%2Ea6V3KB)

Team -
What I’ve learned from my first year and a half in the Senate: we need more Midwest voices in our government. Why? Because Midwesterners embody the core values of Americans. Hard work, fairness, grit.
Midwesterners also know the power of a good offense. You can’t win a football game on defense alone. We can’t just keep telling people what’s wrong and bad – we need to go on offense. We need a plan for how to take this country out of this illness we’re in and lead people towards something better.
That’s why I’m proud today to endorse Midwestern candidates who are running to flip seats – in the House, the Senate, and statewide – in some of the hardest places. These campaigns are rooted in their communities, and they need our support.
We’ll keep adding to this list and continue to highlight the races in purple and pink states.
I hope you will join me in supporting these campaigns,
Elissa

# Trump threatens major Iran strikes and seizure of Kharg Island
President Donald Trump **[announced Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/0d4d252b-fe86-4ff6-a759-30c96dcd7c81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that the US would strike Iran "very hard," declaring that the country's navy, air force, radar systems, and most of its defensive and offensive capabilities had already been destroyed. He also threatened to seize Kharg Island -- Iran's critical oil export hub -- along with other energy infrastructure, comparing a potential takeover to what he described as a successful US arrangement with Venezuela.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0d4d252b-fe86-4ff6-a759-30c96dcd7c81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Kharg Island processes roughly 90% of Iran 's crude oil exports** and is the primary funding source for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. Seizing it would deal a potentially fatal blow to Iran's already-strained economy. While analysts have long viewed the island as a prime strategic target, military planners have hesitated due to the risk of sustained drone, missile, and artillery counterattacks against occupying troops.
* **The latest threats follow a rapid escalation since Tuesday,** when the US fired 49 Tomahawk missiles at Iranian military sites -- including targets near Tehran -- after Iran downed a US Apache helicopter. Iran responded by closing the Strait of Hormuz and launching missile strikes against American military bases in Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait.

As I’m writing this, the Trump administration is trying to change the rules to let the USPS freely deliver handguns through the mail — for the first time in nearly 100 years.

This would be a huge win for the gun lobby, while putting the rest of us in more danger. But there’s still time to speak out.

This bill would require every person to prove they are a U.S. citizen before registering to vote in federal elections. It's as simple as that. It is to seek measures that strengthen election integrity - protecting our Democratic process, and ensuring every American's vote is counted equally and without dilution. Only American citizens, who pledge loyalty to our laws and our values, should decide who will lead our nation. But Democrats are fighting tooth and nail to the SAVE America Act because they want to keep the system They know that without the votes of millions of illegal immigrants, who entered this country under weak Democrat leadership and open-border policies, their power collapses. You will see a massive wave of illegal immigrants voting illegally, but without consequences, in federal elections. Every vote from a true American citizen will be of illegal immigrants. American citizens will lose control of our own country, and Democrats will have cemented their power in lies and fraud. I'm on the front lines in Washington, fighting every single day to protect fair elections and secure our democracy for American citizens. But I can't do this alone. Patriot, I need you with me in my campaign for U.S. Senate. The radical left is pouring into stopping me from keeping another seat in the Senate I can't do this without you. ****************************************************************************************************** **************************************************************************************************** **************************************************************************************************** Thank you for standing with me. name: Virginians for Reproductive Freedom
subject: Your name belongs in this story
body:
https://va4reprofreedom.org/ [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
Friend, history isn’t only shaped by our elected officials or by court decisions.
It’s shaped by individuals like you who show up, speak out, and fight for what’s right.
And thanks to thousands of engaged Virginians, we have a historic opportunity to make reproductive freedom a constitutional right across the Commonwealth in November.
Generations have fought for and dreamed of this moment. But we can't do this without your name, your voice, your vote.
Be a part of history and add your name to the Virginians for Reproductive Freedom scrapbook now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
For generations, families have used scrapbooks to preserve the memories and milestones that matter most.
We’ve created this one to show how a broad coalition of Virginia families, individuals, doctors, nurses, and health care organizations are joining together to fuel this movement. We’ve created this one to show the strength in our numbers.
SIGN THE SCRAPBOOK [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
As this fight enters a critical new phase this summer, we need to demonstrate that support for reproductive freedom reaches every corner of the Commonwealth.
We need to show we’re prepared to vote a resounding “yes” in November that no one can ignore.
As the story of this movement continues to be written, we hope your name will be a part of it.
YES, ADD MY NAME! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
In community,
Hannah Servedio
Organizing Director
P.S. Adding you name to our scrapbook [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2] will help show that Virginians in communities all across the Commonwealth are united for reproductive freedom . Please sign the scrapbook today and consider making a gift [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=061126] to help power the critical work ahead to achieve victory in November.
Visit our website [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
Virginians for Reproductive Freedom
600 Pennsylvania Ave SE Unit 15845
Washington, DC 20003

Hi Derek, Governor Tony Evers here.

I’m writing with an urgent update in the fight to elect Wisconsin’s next Democratic governor: **_As of today, we are officially 2 months away from the primary election that will decide our Democratic nominee._**

61 days, Derek. That’s how long we have to raise the funds, prepare the volunteers, and hire the staff that will allow our nominee to defeat Tom Tiffany in November.

[Can I count on you to send your support to the Battleground Wisconsin Fund with a contribution of $10 right now?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtqfi5wxO8oF1Ng8tCKYXHOeSEE0134uweu1mZK0AAFsnbQeO6i9yd0KhDT0VsvQhg6kHMyiImzLCEAlOKL8sBJtmr4RIaam0ttFY3_awuLTro8NOzwuyFUfpIg-3qBj7N3KtsjAYJzNnDm7UsAOjIGHotc6swiNaEzA6x5hDkL85Bd1Z4BIti1AjoQjy9U_vQET7PT2Wb9NSZZQCZFHtZC1-tn4rbtg_54E4rxX9g5c5qbpddCVIO4vC9mKaqg2KWwCxh3UZ_PSovU0Flem5jYEoadZcEtYBlCuHH5NwYBmI-h9tieweFkYX_TQZoayAYSZhqcxfywHYzy9rvKrdmeApvx3pj-IsF1OPleDzjZaW1HIkfBfipVHHc3J2a0DnM/4re/W3EhOA4aQierxbQtBG9mjA/h1/h001.RjahLHeTeUlTDy7AcxqnkclDxWuBRs69hMIY_qrM94A) | | [Donate Now](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtqfi5wxO8oF1Ng8tCKYXHOeSEE0134uweu1mZK0AAFsnbQeO6i9yd0KhDT0VsvQhg6kHMyiImzLCEAlOKL8sBJtmr4RIaam0ttFY3_awuLTjYKnGWCgvVCqwLALl40cqKi-h1I3Pr1EJiYITPis2nGQ1DUZOCUf7K3u-7gIwEYMUBAlNeUmXNRY3Ma50dBgFkGrarvBWa5LAlBR52h9s9g7NBOnVfEK-89jLZHw4CuWoUcpVg6AlHDjvW7JWCC_cJwp8UCwgW9HclfP6A7ENoIQAgy-E9VqOjBOHElG9uwn45EzVZN2yI7bUZWCiTVhyAG4LBErutf9RTdB-Nobfn0smPcuKuo4kdHPpmDyeAEmxQ4uaSrap_KntxWnk-dRto/4re/W3EhOA4aQierxbQtBG9mjA/h2/h001.zE4uDT6Nmcfdf38ocqUVY9FHsy9Letssnf7E_Wo5gxw)

A senior in Tennessee's 4th District wakes up every morning and does the math.The math of survival. Which prescriptions can she afford this month. Which ones she'll have to cut in half. Whether the food in her refrigerator will last until the next check arrives.
My opponent, Scott DesJarlais, knows this is happening. He sat on committees that dealt directly with pharmaceutical policy. He has had 14 years and every tool available to a sitting congressman to address these issues and **yet voted "yea" on both votes for the "Big Beautiful" Bill, stripping millions of dollars from our healthcare.**
**[I'm not here to pull punches, it's time we call it how it is and fight to make a real difference. Can I count on you to help?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1086f0c6-8f03-4c9f-8ee9-e19c981a882f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CHIP IN $25 HERE!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1086f0c6-8f03-4c9f-8ee9-e19c981a882f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2c77424e-d191-44a3-aed4-75aa946e2b06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
DesJarlais voted against allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices directly with pharmaceutical companies... a straightforward, popular policy that would have immediately lowered costs for millions of Americans. The drug companies rewarded him handsomely. The seniors in this district paid the price. _**Literally.**_
This is not complicated. A doctor in Congress who votes to protect pharmaceutical profits over patients isn't serving his constituents. He's serving his donors. I've sat across from people in this district who are rationing medication because Washington decided their suffering was an acceptable cost of doing business.
Drug companies do not get a seat at my table. The patients do. **Let 's put the people first, [join HERE.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1086f0c6-8f03-4c9f-8ee9-e19c981a882f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

The stakes in New Hampshire could not be higher
Peter, it’s Governor JB Pritzker.
I’m emailing you today about New Hampshire’s Senate race because this is serious: **Senate Republicans’ hand-picked candidate, John Sununu, jumped in to defeat Chris Pappas and flip this open Senate seat red.**
**[Before I go any further, I have to ask: Will you split $10 or more between Chris Pappas and Heartland Patriots to keep New Hampshire blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105172?refcode=em20260611-10554&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10554%2E614464%2EClctOi)**
_Without Chris Pappas winning in New Hampshire, Democrats won’t have a chance at taking back a majority in the Senate._ That’s why this race is being targeted by GOP super PACs and Republicans across the country.
The NRSC — which pours millions into electing Republicans to the Senate — said they’re “all-in” on John Sununu. And polling shows: This race is a _statistical dead heat_ between Chris Pappas and John Sununu.
This means New Hampshire will see historic levels of outside spending, and we have to be ready to fight back.
Chris is a proven fighter for working families — and he’s seen tough campaigns like this before. He knows it takes grassroots support to win a race like this. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, Peter.
**[If you’re with me and ready to send Chris Pappas to the Senate, will you split $10 between Chris’s campaign and Heartland Patriots today to help him defend New Hampshire’s seat?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105172?refcode=em20260611-10554&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=2&akid=10554%2E614464%2EClctOi)**

Will you stand with me?

clean_body: | | | Peter, I am writing this to you because I am at a total loss. Usually, I try to keep a brave face for the public, but the news I just received from the Senate floor has shaken me to my core. I’m humbling myself today because I’ve realized I cannot carry this burden alone. The only way I can see a path forward for our majority—and for President Trump’s agenda—is if my most trusted allies know exactly what we are up against. I’ve written a special note for you. I can only move forward if I know you’re standing with me. Please don’t share this with anyone. God Bless, | | I didn’t run for Senate to sit quietly on the sidelines. I’m a mom, a conservative, and a proud Alabamian—and I came to fight for the values that make America strong. Faith. Family. Freedom. The Left is doing everything they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored. From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way of life—I’m in this for the long haul. This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere. Will you stand with me? Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc. |

And Derek, I remember what the experts told me after it happened. They said it would take months to reopen the roadway. Months of gridlock. Months of traffic jams. Months of headaches for working Pennsylvanians. The next day, I issued a proclamation of disaster emergency to cut through the red tape and provide Commonwealth agencies with the resources they needed to do their jobs. Hours later, crews started working around the clock. Four days after the collapse? We set up a 24/7 livestream of the construction site, so Pennsylvanians could see exactly what their government was up to. No vague, ambiguous statements. No promises without evidence to back it up. The day after that? Pennsylvania union workers began laying the foundation for the interim roadway. Not long after, we made it official: **We reopened six lanes of traffic on I-95 just twelve days after an unprecedented collapse.** We didn’t accept the status quo. We buckled down and got to work. And Derek, I’ve brought that same mindset to everything I do as your Governor. When I took office, I was one of the only Governors in the nation working with a divided legislature — a Republican-controlled State Senate, and a Democratic-controlled State House. In many other states, it was a recipe for gridlock and disaster. But here in Pennsylvania? **We got sh*t done.** Record funding for our public schools. Free breakfasts for every Pennsylvania K-12 student. Seven tax cuts for families, seniors, and small businesses across our Commonwealth. I still hear it from the pundits all the time, Derek: Delivering real, lasting progress in a swing state is impossible — a thing of the past. **But we’re proving them wrong every day.** [**If that’s the kind of leadership that speaks to you, I’m counting on your support throughout this competitive, consequential election year. Because make no mistake: Not every politician agrees with what we’re doing. And if we want to keep it up, we need lots and lots of folks to chip in ahead of our critical End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline. That is why it is absolutely disgraceful that Maine's presumptive Democratic nominee would stoop so low as to attack our service members. How could anyone who served slam our own troops like that?
Our military members sacrifice everything to keep us safe. They deserve our utmost respect, not vile insults from a political candidate.
But he does not care.
He will not apologize or stand up for his actions.
He sleeps soundly knowing that millions are being poured into Maine to support him.
We cannot let them get away with this. We need a leader in the Senate who will fiercely defend our military, not insult them. Senator Collins has always fought to ensure our armed forces have the resources and respect they deserve, but she cannot win this battle alone.
Team Collins needs your help to fight back today and show Graham Platner that Maine respects our troops.

To be honest, I never thought I'd be writing an email like this to you.

I can't express it enough, I'm far from a politician, have never run for public office, and never really considered jumping in until the doors were blown off the massive fraud in Minnesota. What Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the rest of the career politicians have done to Minnesota struck a nerve with me, including when they...
- DEMONIZED our brave men and women in the police- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms- TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits- SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms- STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers- AND SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares
I had the choice to 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) step up and work to fix it.

All the "experts" and consultants told me running as a Republican in Minnesota was a fool's errand...
Yes, we have a far-Left Governor, two far-Left Senators, a state that's trended blue for decades, and the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win.
Truth be told, blazing my own trail doesn't concern me one bit. I won four Emmys for my sports coverage and made TV history. I've taken worse odds on myself and beat them!
That's why I launched this campaign for U.S. Senate. I'm taking on Tim Walz and his inner circle, the DC power brokers, and the political class in Minnesota who have failed us HEAD ON!
Believe it or not, there's a lot more of us than there are of them!

clean_body: Can't express enough how important our time is now. | Hi, it's Michele Tafoya! If my name doesn't ring a bell, allow me to give you a little rundown on who I am and what I believe... I'm new to the political arena. I made a career as a sideline reporter (for some of the biggest moments in sports history). Most Sunday evenings during the season, you'd find me out on the gridiron. I've had the pleasure of interviewing some all-time greats, like Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game FOREVER! Now that you know a little more about my background, let me explain my next endeavor. Before I continue, can you do me a favor and join my campaign, which is arguably the most consequential in the entire country this cycle? I announced my candidacy after my two far-Left opponents, so we're in catch-up mode to make sure when the voters hear our message before heading into the ballot box, they know exactly who they're getting with me. To be honest, I never thought I'd be writing an email like this to you. I can't express it enough, I'm far from a politician, have never run for public office, and never really considered jumping in until the doors were blown off the massive fraud in Minnesota. What Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the rest of the career politicians have done to Minnesota struck a nerve with me, including when they... - DEMONIZED our brave men and women in the police- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms- TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits- SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms- STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers- AND SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares I had the choice to 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) step up and work to fix it. All the "experts" and consultants told me running as a Republican in Minnesota was a fool's errand... Yes, we have a far-Left Governor, two far-Left Senators, a state that's trended blue for decades, and the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. Truth be told, blazing my own trail doesn't concern me one bit. I won four Emmys for my sports coverage and made TV history. I've taken worse odds on myself and beat them! That's why I launched this campaign for U.S. Senate. I'm taking on Tim Walz and his inner circle, the DC power brokers, and the political class in Minnesota who have failed us HEAD ON! Believe it or not, there's a lot more of us than there are of them! Now, with all that being said, my path to winning this race is in your hands. The ONLY way we can flip this seat is by out-organizing, out-working, and out-raising our opponents! The last part is the most critical, because if we can't get our message out far and wide, this race is over before it even gets fully off the ground! | | | | | | | | Thank you for being part of something truly special! Be brave. Do good.- Michele Michele TafoyaRepublican for Senate, Minnesota Imagine the look on Tim Walz's face when voters reject his handpicked candidate and elect a Republican for the first time in 20 years!That's what I'm picturing...This is Michele Tafoya - I'm not a politician, and I've never run for office before.But I made the decision to run for U.S. Senate because my state has fallen so far in such a short amount of time.We have the opportunity of a LIFETIME to win, and I've never been one to give up when the going gets tough.I have a hunch you aren't either. | | Paid for by Tafoya for Senate 3500 Vicksburg LN N, STE 267, Plymouth, MN 55447 To unsubscribe from Tafoya for Senate,

clean_body: A Democratic Senate majority is in play today because of EMILYs List women | = Hey there Peter, I’m sure that you’ve heard this before: Democrats have a tough path ahead to take back the U.S. Senate. But that doesn’t mean the Senate is out of our reach. Not even close. Across the country, Democratic candidates are gaining momentum. Trump and his MAGA agenda are more unpopular by the day. And in some of the highest-stakes races on the map, EMILYs List women are stepping up to compete — and win. That’s why we’re launching our Flip the Senate Fund. For the next 48 hours only, we’re raising $75,000 to help Democratic pro-choice women build the campaigns they need to take back the Senate. = | = Mary Peltola (AK-SEN) is running for U.S. Senate in Alaska, where she has already proven she can win tough statewide races by putting Alaskans first. EMILYs List endorsed Mary on day one because we know she has what it takes to compete, win, and deliver a safer, more affordable future for Alaska families. Lindsey Graham has backed a cruel MAGA agenda that has made life harder for the people he’s supposed to serve. **Jack Cocchiarella** and I covered a lot of ground in this one. We started with sports, somehow ended up talking about billionaires, and spent most of the conversation digging into why Congress feels more disconnected than ever from the people it's supposed to represent. We got fired up about the future of the Democratic Party, the fight over healthcare, and what it actually means to build a country that works for working people.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We kick things off with a conversation about sports loyalty, college football rivalries, and why some traditions still matter more than ever.
* [**00:07:00**] Mike Johnson's comments on Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid spark a larger debate about what Republicans are really planning next.
* [**00:13:08**] We talk about big ideas, public ambition, and why Democrats need to start building things again instead of settling for small expectations.
* [**00:24:18**] A deep dive into wealth, political power, congressional pay, and why ordinary people are increasingly locked out of public office.
* [**00:34:32**] We tackle billionaires, private equity, AI, and what happens when a handful of people control more wealth than entire communities.

At its core, this episode is about power--who has it, who doesn't, and what happens when politics stops solving problems for everyday people. clean_body: | | | Across the Commonwealth | VIRGINIA SUNBUCKS APPLICATIONS NOW AVAILABLE ONLINE Good news for families! All are now able to apply for Virginia SUN Bucks online at There is no paperwork to print and no phone call required - just fill out the form on your computer or phone! If you are unsure if you need to apply, take the quick quiz at ~ to check your status. | | ~ VPLC ROANOKE TENANT TOWN HALL - TONIGHT Tonight from 6-7 pm at Hill Street Baptist Church, join the Virginia Poverty Law Center and Legal Aid Society of Roanoke Valley to learn about new tenant protections, ask questions, and share your experience as a tenant in Virginia. Participants will hear plain-language explanations of recent housing law changes and have the opportunity to discuss what is -- and is not -- working for tenants in their communities. | In the Community | | FEDUP WALK HONORING THOSE LOST TO GUN VIOLENCE We lose so many to gun violence every year, including here at home. Last week in Roanoke, we honored those lost with FEDUP. The MLK bridge was full of beautiful faces that no longer get to live their dreams. Together we remember their legacy and continue to fight to put an end to gun violence in our communities | SECRETARY OF LABOR VISITS EXCEL CENTER IN ROANOKE It's been nearly a year since the Excel Center opened its doors to students, and they are thriving! This team has built an amazing network to support our adult learners in achieving their high school diploma and has benefited over 100 students so far. Yesterday, we got to show off their phenomenal work to our Secretary of Labor, Secretary Looman, and emphasize the importance of investing resources like Excel in our community. | GOODWILL HIRING EVENT - June 12 Tomorrow there will be a Goodwill Hiring Event at Melrose Plaza. Hiring managers will be conducting on-the-spot interviews for positions primarily at their Goodwill Cave Spring and Hollins store locations, while also considering candidates for opportunities at other Roanoke and Salem stores, as well as the Market on Melrose. Come prepared to discuss your experience and learn about available positions. | THE ULTIMATE BUSINESS MIXER EVENT - June 12 Join The Ultimate Business Mixer for networking, great vibes, and endless opportunities in person at the Lamplighter Mall Shopping Center tomorrow from 6-8 pm. Get ready to network like never before at The Ultimate Business Mixer! This in-person event is your chance to meet movers and shakers, swap ideas, and make connections that could boost your career or biz. | MONSTER FLEA MARKET - June 13 Berglund Center invites you to experience the biggest flea market in Roanoke at Monster Flea on June 13th! This event will have over 200 vendors that will be selling many different types of items. These items range from gently used to brand new. Get ready to score some amazing deals on one-of-a-kind items! This event offers free admission and free parking! | PRIDE MONTH BLOOD DRIVE AT UUCR - June 13 On Saturday, the Unitarian Universalist Church of Roanoke is hosting a blood drive in conjunction with the American Red Cross. The event is from 10am - 2pm at the church (2015 Grandin Rd SW). Everyone is welcome to donate blood, especially our community's LGBTQ+ citizens! The Red Cross welcomes all for their blood donation. Donate blood and save lives! ~~ | | | RIDE & READ WILLIAMSON ROAD LIBRARY Come to the Ride and Read festival happening 10 am to 1 pm on Saturday, June 13, at the Williamson Road Branch Library (3837 Williamson Rd. NW). This touch-a-truck event will feature over 20 vehicles for kids to explore! Free food and children's books will also be available. | RCPS FREE SUMMER MEALS Roanoke City Public Schools will offer free summer meals to children ages 18 years or younger June 8-July 31 through the USDA's Summer Food Service Program (SFSP). Meals are provided on-site on a first-come, first-served basis at school locations. Dates and times will vary by location. ~ | Community Resources | COMMUNITY OFFICE HOURS VIRTUAL OFFICE HOURS WITH DEL. RASOUL'S TEAM Our office is now holding virtual office hours to meet with constituents. Meet with a member of Delegate Sam Rasoul's team to ask questions, share concerns, or get help with state-related issues. We're here to listen and assist however we can. ~~ | | KNOW YOUR RIGHTS WITH ICE There have been recent reports of ICE throughout the state. The ACLU has created a collection of resources in the case you or someone you know interacts with ICE agents. Read and share the resources found ~~. ~~ | CONTACT YOUR FEDERAL REPRESENTATIVE In many ways, it feels like our federal government is under attack by the current administration. While our office is happy to assist however we can, it is still crucial that you engage our federal representatives. Find the contact information for the Virginia Congressional Delegation ~~. ~~ | JOIN THE ROANOKE CITY DEMOCRATS! RCDC's monthly business meeting is the third Thursday each month. Watch their Facebook for an upcoming announcement of the agenda. The meetings are available virtually for those who write to mailto:info@roanokedemocrats.com, requesting the link. ~~ | JOIN ROANOKE YOUNG DEMS! We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.
_Please see a special message from our sponsor. | | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

name: James Carville, Senior Democratic Strategist
subject: My honest assessment of New Hampshire.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The math to flip the Senate runs through New Hampshire. Here’s why that should concern you.
Hi. It's James Carville.
I’ve been watching Senate races for decades. What I’m seeing in New Hampshire right now is keeping me up at night — and it should concern y’all too.
I put together a brief memo. Read it. Then let’s help Chris Pappas win this race.
**[If you don’t need convincing, rush a donation to Chris Pappas’s campaign now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260611_1.VdkW5w&refcode=em20260611-1&t=1&akid=7129%2E582294%2E_k6LMf)**
**[Donate »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260611_1.VdkW5w&refcode=em20260611-1&t=2&akid=7129%2E582294%2E_k6LMf)**
* * *
**SPRING 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON NH-SEN**
**FROM:** James Carville, Senior Democratic Strategist
**TO:** Interested Parties
I need to be clear with you about where things stand in the race for New Hampshire’s open Senate seat.
**The New Hampshire Senate race has been in the margin of error for months — and it’s not getting the attention it deserves.**
* Three recent polls show this race in a dead heat:
* Emerson (March 2026): Pappas 45–Sununu 44
* St. Anselm (March 2026): Pappas 46–Sununu 43
* St. Anselm (November 2025): Pappas 44–Sununu 41
* All of these polls show this race **within the margin of error. The race has been functionally tied for months.**
* New Hampshire’s open Senate seat is sitting in a dead heat with significantly less financial firepower on our side than we have in other Senate races.
* This race will almost certainly be decided by whether Chris Pappas has the resources to compete on the airwaves and on the ground in the final stretch.

**The GOP knows exactly what’s at stake here — and they’re already moving.**
* The Senate Leadership Fund has committed over $17 million to elect John Sununu — their largest investment in New Hampshire in a decade.
* John Sununu is not a back-bench candidate. He has a famous New Hampshire political name (his father and his brother both served as governor), a history of winning statewide, and the full weight of the Republican donor machine behind him.
* And here’s something voters in New Hampshire deserve to know: Sununu left the Senate in 2009 and spent the years following building a personal fortune — with assets estimated as high as $36 million — through corporate board positions and investments in oil and gas companies, including ExxonMobil, Shell, and more. He left New Hampshire, cashed in, and now wants to come back.
* Republicans understand the math perfectly. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire’s Senate seat and make Democrats’ path to a majority impossible.

**New Hampshire has decided elections before — and the margins are razor thin.**
* In 2016, the last time New Hampshire had a race for an open Senate seat, the race was decided by just 1,017 votes.
* When Democrats chart a path to retaking the Senate majority, New Hampshire is not optional. If Chris Pappas loses, Democrats need to flip five seats instead of four. That math does not exist.

**There is a recent and painful precedent for underestimating a close race.**
* Bob Casey narrowly led in Pennsylvania polling for virtually the entire 2024 cycle — and lost in an upset that shocked the entire party.
* A race that has been tied for six months is not a comfortable position. It is a warning sign. I have seen what happens when we assume a race is in-hand and the resources don’t follow.
* We cannot afford to let New Hampshire’s 2026 race echo Pennsylvania’s in 2024.

**Chris Pappas has what it takes to win — but the outside spending gap is real.**
* Pappas has won New Hampshire’s toughest congressional district four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle. His campaign has outraised Sununu candidate-to-candidate with $4.2 million cash on hand to Sununu’s $1.9 million.
* But that advantage disappears the moment the Senate Leadership Fund’s $17 million hits the airwaves. In a race decided by a handful of votes, being drowned out on TV by Republican money in the final weeks is the ballgame.
* This is the moment to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the race you wish you’d paid more attention to.

* * *
Listen: I don’t write memos like this for every race. I wrote this one because I’m genuinely worried about what happens if New Hampshire slips away while everyone’s looking somewhere else.
The numbers are clear. The stakes are real. Now I need you to act.
**[Rush a donation to Chris Pappas right now. Don’t let New Hampshire be the race we wish we’d paid more attention to.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260611_1.VdkW5w&refcode=em20260611-1&t=3&akid=7129%2E582294%2E_k6LMf)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260611_1.VdkW5w&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-1&t=4&akid=7129%2E582294%2E_k6LMf)**
Thank you for your support. Let’s elect Chris Pappas and flip the Senate.
– James Carville

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Elon Musk Just Declared War on the IRS. body:
Trump-Endorsed Conservative Releases Agenda Focused on Border Security, Lower Costs, Energy Dominance, and Protecting Louisiana Families

| | |
---

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEJune 11, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**LETLOW UNVEILS 15-POINT PLAN TO PUT LOUISIANA FIRST IN THE U.S. SENATE** _Trump-Endorsed Conservative Releases Agenda Focused on Border Security, Lower Costs, Energy Dominance, and Protecting Louisiana Families_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow has unveiled a 15-point plan outlining the priorities she will fight for in the United States Senate, centered on keeping the border secure, lowering costs, strengthening Louisiana's economy, protecting families, and advancing President Trump's America First agenda.
_"As a mother, educator, and conservative, I believe public service is about protecting our families, defending our values, and leaving our children a stronger America than the one we inherited,"_ **said Congresswoman Letlow.** _"President Trump needs partners in the Senate who will help achieve this mission. My priorities are straightforward: keep our communities safe, lower costs, protect parents and children, unleash American energy, and always put Louisiana first."_
**Letlow's 15 priorities for the United States Senate include:**
**1\. Secure the Border and Deport Criminal Illegal Aliens** Make President Trump's border security policies permanent and support law enforcement.
**2\. Lower Costs and Make Life Affordable Again** Cut taxes, reduce inflationary spending, and help Louisiana families keep more of what they earn.
**3\. Protect Parents' Rights and Put Families First** Ensure parents remain in charge of their children's education, upbringing, and future.
**4\. Protect Women's Sports and Defend Common Sense** Keep biological men out of women's sports and protect opportunities for girls and young women.
**5\. Protect Election Integrity and Pass the SAVE America Act** Require proof of citizenship to vote and strengthen confidence in American elections.
**6\. Ban Congressional Insider Trading and Drain the Swamp** Hold elected officials accountable and restore trust in government.
**7\. Secure American Energy Dominance** Unleash Louisiana energy production, expand LNG exports, and lower energy costs.
**8\. Fight for Louisiana Farmers and Rural Communities** Support agriculture, strengthen rural economies, and deliver a strong Farm Bill.
**9\. Stand Up for Louisiana Fishermen and Seafood Producers** Protect Louisiana seafood industries from unfair foreign competition and federal overreach.
**10\. Fix the Flood Insurance Crisis** Fight for affordable flood insurance and reform the National Flood Insurance Program.
**11\. Support Veterans and Military Families** Ensure veterans receive the care, benefits, and support they have earned through service.
**12\. Protect Louisiana's Coast and Improve Disaster Recovery** Strengthen coastal restoration efforts and improve hurricane recovery programs.
**13\. Make America Healthy Again and Fix Our Food Supply** Promote healthier food, greater transparency, and better outcomes for American families.
**14\. Rebuild America's Shipyards and Maritime Industry** Strengthen Louisiana's role in national defense, shipbuilding, and maritime commerce.
**15\. Put Louisiana First** Fight every day to ensure Louisiana families, workers, businesses, and communities have a strong voice in Washington.
The full details of Letlow’s U.S. Senate priorities can be found [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/fN0yXzOttpP?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a).

name: Elizabeth For Virginia
subject: Our Weekly Newsletter Is Here!
body:
Read our updates from the campaign trail!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/elizabethforvirginia/our-weekly-newsletter-is-here-0lbxp5otlt?e=2f83c585b2)
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | |
# _Our Weekly Newsletter Is Here!_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**We had an incredible week on the campaign trail! We are so grateful to every single one of you that came out and supported us this week.****On Thursday, Elizabeth had a great time at the Gloucester Dems Candidate Forum, where she and six other candidates welcomed an incredible turnout in the Northern Neck. **
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Saturday welcomed another candidate forum in Williamsburg, where Elizabeth was asked whether or not she would like to vote to impeach President Trump. She answered with an immediate ‘YES’, earning a strong round of applause. And while Elizabeth and the other candidates sat with voters at the forum, we noticed a few empty seats... **
---
| |
---
| |
**Elizabeth also had a wonderful time joining the Wear Blue: Run To Remember organization on Saturday morning, joining their team to honor the service and sacrifice of the American military while supporting the families who live with that loss every day. If you are interested in joining this organization going forwards, they meet the first Saturday of every month. You can find more information **[**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/zcUoXGPUwvM?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**!****On Monday, Elizabeth was honored to join the NAACP in Williamsburg, where she discussed recent events in the community involving the school district and funding for education. While talking to attendees, she was proud to explain her commitment to restoring voting rights, protecting reproductive freedom, and working through redistricting challenges. ****The rest of the week was busy as well: on Tuesday, Elizabeth met with the Chesterfield County Dems, where she spoke about her campaign and met new voters in the community. On Wednesday, Elizabeth was excited to join the Like Minded Women of Hanover County to talk politics, the campaign, and about issues that mattered to the community. Later that evening, Elizabeth joined the Colonial Democrats to speak about her campaign and engage with voters. ****Tonight, the campaign is excited to join the Outloud RVA Celebration in Richmond, where we will celebrate Pride with fun events in the community, live music, and resource sharing. ****Have a great rest of your week, Virginia!**
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Upcoming Events:**

**There are so many new ways to get involved with the campaign! As usual, we will be hosting phonebanks every week on Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday. On Friday evening, we’re excited to host a**[**canvas in Henrico**](https://us.list-manage.com/143R9y_j1iF?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**from 5 to 7pm ET. Come out and join us!****We’ve got a busy Saturday planned. We’ll start the morning by joining the**[**Matthews County Dems**](https://us.list-manage.com/1CqjRrrR0Ae?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**, where Elizabeth will share updates about the campaign. Then, we’ll be joining the **[**New Kent Juneteenth**](https://us.list-manage.com/4PdIiVhWQwa?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)** celebration and honoring freedom and unity. That evening, we;ll be hosting a **[**canvass in Williamsburg**](https://us.list-manage.com/eVWPc16SpzH?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**at 1:30, before joining a**[**pride parade**](https://us.list-manage.com/1PZq2jNW2TI?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**in the Historic Triangle.****We’ve got lots of events planned - come celebrate with us!**
---

**$5** helps us do the work that wins elections in a state as big as Texas, like expanding our statewide organizing and staying on the road to earn votes everywhere, from El Paso to Houston, from Amarillo to Brownsville, and every small town in between.
**$5** — especially before the end-of-quarter deadline at the end of the month — will help us run ads and ensure we hit our fundraising goals.

subject: The easy part is over
body:
While we celebrate this win, the Left is not taking a single day off - and neither can we. |
---

Peter,

The votes are in - and South Carolina Republicans have spoken loudly and clearly.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=088762e826044503afa0db1118aff236&_e=_K4Ogyn5cnJL0b1NIg_1WBscaEVp1FECuX9ujarrYtxH0Jxw8aNPPCRybAwnMCXwuIyIlTOeHcmWVzOHRZp-a9MV3YFHRfUxVWmFOl7-W2jeKns9uxeyfuPEtpCn3ayXIQQiT9D7RtQr_2TAdLjDuY_whb7vmGX9eiZivZ-eSG5qLsjCygA2Pom-sAWfNQAdWhi_xK_P7dnBvXjUGEESS_GXoY-QnyiaUxn-DLsFhmcDoRF3GSGafloS-uurq2g3bGPNY4Gc5k7N7C_RUhDIHehrSiARkpKDOWqyiqYbt_JfMZ_Mae2TBJSsr8CPZ_nokQIoMWfy-6B48icuiXDWReX8mBi6VRCbzHmYuiHwvIpZibOQGy-YuzNCxpynCq2fa3uJpLrwzWe9hBq9w_EpAlGZswmqsERYbPyJN4iDbQB89O53zvgzqxiJ-lVOH2lUHdAA2TniucCMwG5meOYJY8hdzleTmJZNFcNEko5JngDnOmNTyiUl_rLfwnF240U2nuqsR3P2UlQce2vth7-6Bhp5zusK9KougmnY30WoL8tprem3HCrOT2E1akLwAIJ1IjLymrfaJedmyF6BHKlnlorhzfSGpsXo0kfigT7SL3DyrJYaEcCLcja19ilwDkJ2pv0WSHBCQICo8ixvUa2tS4RJFSPYKudMgfurZBX12LRFhTcFYM8yDl9qPhyTriZkEb-972fLfNDxYvKK--o-7jP_hK_s46hhMxIzo3MQmsivfIsKb7Xct0A5BVLzjnCa-VpPA37WJtAjposzubWJAQKGSoitT2E4gOJhtejsB5Q%3D)
I am honored to carry this nomination, and I will not take a single day of this fight for granted.

I'm not a career politician. I'm a classroom teacher, a wife, and someone who has spent my life helping others find their voice. Growing up with a learning disability, I learned early on how to face challenges head-on. That experience shaped who I am and led me to the classroom, where I now work with students, especially those who struggle with speech and learning, to build confidence and succeed. Now I'm stepping forward to serve Virginia's 10th District because our families deserve leadership that understands what they're going through. I'm focused on stronger schools, a more affordable cost of living, safe communities, and leadership rooted in integrity. Running a serious congressional campaign in Northern Virginia requires resources. The media market is expensive. Reaching voters across the district takes real investment. And our opponents will have plenty of money behind them. That is why I am asking for your help today. If you believe we need strong leadership representing Virginia's 10th District in Washington, please consider making a contribution today. $25 helps us reach new voters online $50 helps expand our grassroots outreach $100 helps us grow our campaign across the district $250 helps us compete with the political machines that want to control this race Every dollar helps us build the campaign infrastructure needed to win and ensure that the people of Northern Virginia have a strong voice in Washington.
This race will be decided by people like you who care enough to step forward early and help build the momentum we need. Thank you for standing with me. Julie Perry Candidate for Congress Virginia's 10th District

Happy Pride, Derek!

Pride Month is a time to celebrate the accomplishments, the joy, and the resilience of the LGBTQ community.
As you may already know, my daughter, Molly, is gay and she is married to an incredible woman. Together they are creating a beautiful family and life. When I was elected to Congress, I made a promise to Molly to do everything in my power to protect and defend the LGBTQ community. It’s one of the reasons I helped the House pass the historic Equality Act to guarantee all LGBTQ Americans the full protection of federal civil rights laws. And it's why I won’t stop until the Equality Act is signed into law.

As I write this, I'm thinking about my own family and the countless families across the country that are stronger today for embracing our diversity and differences. And I’m thinking about the very real fear our community is experiencing as the Trump administration attacks key rights and protections.

No matter who or what we're up against, I'm continuing this fight to ensure everyone has the right to love and live as they like.

In a just America, love is love. That’s what I’m fighting for right now – I hope you’ll join me.
There's work to be done.

Chrissy

Wall Street is divided over SpaceX's record-breaking IPO set to raise $75 billion dollars at a $1.7 trillion dollar valuation **[as bulls see Musk's vision](https://substack.com/redirect/9613c745-aeff-4eae-a6cc-88b014d2c729?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while others question fundamentals.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ede80c90-55d2-415d-94bb-5ad86f996f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue Growth Noted:** SpaceX reported $18.67 billion dollars revenue in 2025 up 33% yet posted a $4.94 billion dollar net loss.
* **Valuation Concerns Raised:** At the IPO price the valuation represents about 94x times trailing sales raising questions about whether it is untethered from fundamentals.
* **Bullish Merger View:** Analyst Dan Ives sees more than 80% chance of SpaceX merging with Tesla post IPO creating a Musk conglomerate controlling more of the AI ecosystem.
* **Data Center Success:** SpaceX's Colossus facility in Memphis delivers over 300 megawatts of AI compute using 220,000 Nvidia GPUs.

---|---|---
* **Capital Raise Digestible:** SpaceX $75 billion raise fits within monthly equity issuance patterns with four companies seeking $380 billion total representing two months of issuance.
* **IPO Volatility Expected:** Major IPOs typically see median 9% drop one year later with 54% average drawdowns in first twelve months.

# [OpenAI pursues massive 10 Gigawatt Ohio data center](https://substack.com/redirect/ac17a5bc-db06-40ec-ba59-cafa0de4b6a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI is in advanced talks **[to lease a proposed 10 gigawatt data center campus on federal land in Ohio](https://substack.com/redirect/6a3362ce-ae46-499d-8440-160df328d555?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** potentially with Nvidia financial backing in what would be the largest such development ever.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ede80c90-55d2-415d-94bb-5ad86f996f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Enormous Scale Planned:** The 10 gigawatt facility could cost over $500 billion dollars and requires dedicated power generation substations and phased construction with first phase online in 2028.
* **Power Consumption Huge:** 10 gigawatts equals output of several large nuclear reactors or 10 large gas fired power plants each gigawatt powering roughly 700,000 to one million homes.
* **Regulatory Response:** Ohio lawmakers introduced Substitute House Bill 646 to create new electric rate class ensuring data centers pay full costs and protect ratepayers.
* **IPO Timing Context:** The news comes days after OpenAI submitted draft IPO prospectus to SEC amid booming data center capex by hyperscalers.

name: Nico, United We Dream
subject: American in every way but on paper
body:
14 years later, American in every way but on paper — and the fight isn't over. Chip in today. | | | Peter — Next week, we celebrate the 14th anniversary of DACA and the resilience of our movement! DACA exists because immigrant youth refused to take no for an answer: we organized, we persisted, and we made real what everyone called impossible. _Together, we protected our community and made this country stronger._ **[However, as we celebrate these last 14 years of resilience, DACA is currently being dismantled through a thousand calculated cuts and largely behind the scenes. United We Dream is organizing every day to stop these attacks and secure a pathway to citizenship. Please chip in $14 or more to support this ongoing work.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeRSb6UyzukpYsZgexseLha1n3hAbO_p8Utnp75qrFZNq3NtNhEgiWPVyHPRf7RT9Hali9jsPWAzZPdnmPwplNeaoqmrgSzSeBvrZJenKhVcK0KhSNAC9daWYVZzVmO-SjGgDoVvgxxZXe_Ul3FWIK61QVNBL1qpJli3EjjBD24L8x9IhYAtw3k-scetUowl8DamDE1vbRmack9ZRsf9bs2g6OzO6dLVThE8uZmdagPVOSWCU-Xrsq08gdeDMT3Kp9-qqQ8WG9KMSDxnHXdJVUZRkV9D1wwMl9SPkeabMK4MzCs1m85045Vh5JuY5Ez_Vw9VrljCzfsf6JUuUPuXTuYohwD3Otm1H6S8UyKBClQB8rXibhIYUzaSLeQ17vIea96AfgzqzZe46ketGNnBfu9Q/4re/gfvkBh8SSzS-MR1Z0XVkfg/h0/h001.3nL4Gn8DHj0UYQoCYAgOGCslyOCWBAtpRvYPdNopiAw)** DACA recipients were promised protection from deportation. Instead, under this administration, our coworkers, friends, and classmates are being detained and cruelly separated from their families as part of an intentional mass delegalization and mass deportation agenda that also targets TPS, refugee, and asylum protection. The program faces escalating attacks on every front. Active litigation could soon strip DACA recipients in Texas of their right to work.1 Immigration and federal agents are detaining and deporting DACA recipients despite their valid DACA protections.2 And renewals that once took just weeks can now stretch past six months,3 pushing people out of status and out of work. _This is a five-alarm fire._ **Despite it all, this anniversary is a reminder that we power each other. We _refuse_ to stay silent in the face of these rising threats against our safety, rights, and futures. We keep our communities safe.** When we come together, we're powerful. United We Dream is building a future where everyone's needs are met — where we drive the change and deliver a pathway to citizenship. clean_body: 14 years later, American in every way but on paper — and the fight isn't over. Chip in today. | | | Peter — Next week, we celebrate the 14th anniversary of DACA and the resilience of our movement! DACA exists because immigrant youth refused to take no for an answer: we organized, we persisted, and we made real what everyone called impossible. Together, we protected our community and made this country stronger. DACA recipients were promised protection from deportation. Instead, under this administration, our coworkers, friends, and classmates are being detained and cruelly separated from their families as part of an intentional mass delegalization and mass deportation agenda that also targets TPS, refugee, and asylum protection. The program faces escalating attacks on every front. Active litigation could soon strip DACA recipients in Texas of their right to work.1 Immigration and federal agents are detaining and deporting DACA recipients despite their valid DACA protections.2 And renewals that once took just weeks can now stretch past six months,3 pushing people out of status and out of work. This is a five-alarm fire. Despite it all, this anniversary is a reminder that we power each other. We refuse to stay silent in the face of these rising threats against our safety, rights, and futures. We keep our communities safe. When we come together, we're powerful. United We Dream is building a future where everyone's needs are met — where we drive the change and deliver a pathway to citizenship. We power our country, and we'll continue to build the world we hope for. subject: Can't Stop, Won't Stop: Elect Melat Kiros
body:
15 things to do with Team Kiros
| |
---
| Hi Peter, Last weekend you showed up. You knocked doors, made calls, spread the word, and brought the energy this campaign runs on. We felt it. And now it's a new week — which means a whole new list.
## 15 Things You Can Do This Weekend to Elect Melat Kiros
Fifteen. We're not slowing down, but we are saving lots of spots for you to jump in.
##
Thursday-Sun **1\. Join a Canvass** Whether you're a seasoned canvasser or have never knocked a door in your life, you are welcome and encouraged to attend. All canvasses will begin with a training, and you can always choose to go with a buddy. Thursday Canvasses at 5:30pm. [**Find another canvass.**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=6b49fd8a3dca767a4907dd8b354a2b9ff355e157&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fcanvass) **2\. Help us canvass in your apartment building.** So far, our volunteers have knocked thousands of doors across the city—now we're ready to take it to the next level by reaching our neighbors in apartment buildings. We need your help to make it happen. **[Sign up to volunteer.](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=a6bc9374ad30058176224954105f093bc366770d&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fapartments)** Friday **3\. Jews for Melat Shabbat** Join us for the launch of Jews for Melat by welcoming in Shabbat at a picknick/potluck with a coalition of progressive Jews, and Melat herself. City Park. [RSVP for exact location.](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=083e79e4ed26b6ce68c068777fec372042c5150a&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fjews-for-melat-shabbat) Fri 5:30-8:30 **4\. Get your "Melat Kiros for Congress" yard sign** Show your support for Melat Kiros. Fill out this form and we will deliver a yard sign directly to your home. **[Request yours now.](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=035117f81ab2b98df513134dbb49470050392725&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Fyardsign)** Saturday **5\. City Park Farmer's Market** Team Kiros will be talking to voters during the regular City Park Farmers Market. [**Register here.**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=101e6df9a6ce40a63d03b69250044664efa0706f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Ftabling) Sat 9am-1pm **6\. Harvey Park Farmer's Market** Team Kiros will be talking to voters during the regular Harvey Park Farmers Market. [**Register here.**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=101e6df9a6ce40a63d03b69250044664efa0706f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Ftabling) Sat 10am-1pm **7\. Denver Bike Fest** Team Kiros will be talking to voters during the Denver Bike Fest. [**Register here.**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/A8euXgQOANCU4VjION8JNm3fyOSyxVv4/click?signature=101e6df9a6ce40a63d03b69250044664efa0706f&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwin.kirosforco.com%2Ftabling) Sat 3-5pm **8\. Canvass with Rep. Tim Hernández** Join Tim Hernández and the rest of our volunteer team for a canvass in Southwest Denver to chat with your neighbors about Melat's people-powered vision for our country. body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Tensions between Trump and Netanyahu have reached new heights. Hours after
Trump vowed: "I call all the shots" and told Israel not to bomb Iran,
Israel bombed anyway. And yet, Congress is quickly moving ahead with a
TERRIFYING provision in the new Pentagon budget that would tie the U.S. to
the Israeli military more than ever before.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39039?source=email-20260611&t=1011&akid=10869%2E5885482%2ESRig6h ]Headline: Congress Advances US-Israeli military integration plan. A
provision in the draft 2027 US defense bill could bind the countries
weapons industries closer than ever.

If this passes, it won’t just mean sending more taxpayer dollars to Israel
– it would mean co-producing weapons, turning the U.S. military’s data
into the Israeli military’s data too, and greenlighting UNPRECEDENTED
Israeli influence on the U.S. – all with less oversight than ever before.

We cannot let them sneak this through – but to stop it, we need to
overwhelm Congress with opposition to this toxic merger right now.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39039?source=email-20260611&t=1012&akid=10869%2E5885482%2ESRig6h ]Tell Congress now: Strip Section 224 from the Pentagon Budget – NO to
an unchecked US-Israel weapons merger!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39039?source=email-20260611&t=1013&akid=10869%2E5885482%2ESRig6h ]ADD YOUR NAME

Polling shows public distrust of the Israeli government has skyrocketed.
Together, we watched in horror as violence across Gaza killed tens of
thousands of men, women, and children. And now, Netanyahu and Trump are
sparring publicly over who is in charge.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39039?source=email-20260611&t=1014&akid=10869%2E5885482%2ESRig6h ]Headline: Netanyahu says Israel will strike Iran 'whenever necessary'
after Trump's 'I call the shots' remark.

Section 224 would make it all MUCH worse. Netanyahu has called it "my
plan" – putting the U.S. on the hook for even more US-made bombs, more
joint surveillance operations, and more weapons stampeding through the
export pipeline – all without public oversight or accountability.

Congressional leaders are banking on the fact they can sneak this through
with little attention. They want to keep these deals in the dark, far from
public scrutiny.

Both Our Revolution ally Rep. Ro Khanna and Rep. Thomas Massie have
promised to fight it on the floor – and it’s going to take ALL of us to
make sure enough members of Congress join them to stop this dangerous
plan.

If we don’t make enough noise NOW, this could become law without a public
fight. Our Revolution was built to shine a spotlight on exactly this kind
of backroom dealmaking. Your voice can help expose and stop this before
it’s too late.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39039?source=email-20260611&t=1015&akid=10869%2E5885482%2ESRig6h ]Add your name RIGHT NOW to tell Congress: No new US-Israel
military-industrial merger!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39039?source=email-20260611&t=1016&akid=10869%2E5885482%2ESRig6h ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133153542/626897959/-153530995?refcode=EM_F_260611ICE_N_SB_90DO_4_NG_N_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmZlZTU5ZC1jMzY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eiJ49igoy-NO9UWm_enDmZKFhG7oqS162Xw8WQbRaoE=) Peter,

Republicans in the House recently passed a Budget Reconciliation bill that included over $60 billion slush fund for ICE and CBP. Despite the fact that these agencies already have over $100 billion in additional funds, the GOP funneled more money their way.

Under Trump, these agencies have created chaos, pain, and suffering – making our country less safe. This is happening as they waste taxpayer dollars by acting like they’re above the law. Trump’s ICE doesn’t deserve one more penny – which is why **_I was proud to vote NO_.** Instead of giving billions to an agency to brutalize our communities, we should be addressing soaring prices and the Republican-created healthcare crisis.

Republicans have shown that they won’t do anything to help the American people. But I am ready to take action. That’s why I introduced the **Feeding Families Not Fear Act** with Congressman McGovern to repeal the ICE slush fund and put that money back in SNAP, where it belongs. We can’t keep giving a reckless blank check to ICE at the expense of hardworking Americans.

[**We’re fighting back against this backward regime, but to be successful, we must take back the House. Please donate $5 today and help us put a check and balance on this administration.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133153543/626897960/-153530995?refcode=EM_F_260611ICE_N_SB_90DO_4_NG_N_L1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNmZlZTU5ZC1jMzY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eiJ49igoy-NO9UWm_enDmZKFhG7oqS162Xw8WQbRaoE=)

Onward,

Shontel Brown | Shontel Brown is proud to be elected as the Congresswoman for Ohio’s 11th District. She has spent the last decade serving the people of Ohio and building coalitions. As she enters her second full term in Congress, she will use that experience to continue the fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and to preserve and protect our democracy for generations to come. Will you join her and be the change we need?
