name: Mallory McMorrow
subject: I refuse to just sit on my hands
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McMorrow for Michigan
body:
Age limits, term limits, and actual accountability for the highest court.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4945%2E898137%2EjC6HwX)
Hi there —
I was out at one of our brewery tour stops the other day doing a Q&A, and someone asked me a question that’s probably crossed your mind too: _What do we do about the U.S. Supreme Court?_
I looked around the room and asked if anyone thought the Court was actually doing its job right now. The answer was a nearly unanimous, resounding "No."
It took me right back to a few years ago when _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned. I got a phone call at my office from a 15-year-old girl in my district. She was in tears. She told me, _“I thought this was a right. I thought it was done.”_
It broke my heart because she was right to assume that. But the painful reality we're living in is that**nothing is guaranteed anymore**. Not with this Supreme Court.
That’s why I firmly believe that every single option has to be on the table. We need to talk about expanding the court. We need to talk about term limits and age limits. We need real, enforceable ethics laws. Justices should _NOT_ be allowed to oversee themselves.
As the Vice Chair of the Oversight Committee in the State Senate, I know what real accountability looks like. If you commit ethics violations, you should be removed from the court.**Plain and simple.**
[**We can't just sit back and hope things get better — we have to actively build the future we want to see. If you’re with me in this fight to hold the court accountable and protect our fundamental rights, could you donate $10?**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/128?c0=mam-em-june2026.IXNKXm&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260611_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4945%2E898137%2EjC6HwX)

Thanks for always having my back. It means the world.
– Mallory

**July 1, 2019**
My family and I watched Scranton’s former mayor resign in disgrace after pleading guilty to federal corruption charges, criminal conspiracy, bribery, and attempted extortion. **August 21, 2019**
I announced my Independent campaign for Scranton mayor and against the local Democratic Party’s cronyism. Our campaign was dubbed _Paige Against the Machine._ **January 6, 2020**
I became the first female mayor of Scranton after winning a tough election against the local Democratic machine — all while eight months pregnant. Over the past six and a half years, we cleaned up City Hall, balanced the books, cut red tape, and brought hundreds of small businesses and over a thousand homes to our neighborhoods. **September 2, 2025**
We launched this campaign for Congress to challenge corrupt Rob Bresnahan and restore accountability in NEPA. It somehow feels like a lifetime ago and just yesterday. **May 19, 2026**

name: Dennis Price, Heroes for Humanity
subject: This is the moment most people never see
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere.

| | | | | |
---
[ ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=53dd8fc496b9411881b20a7046552159&_e=sMIGKUB1nUhNmTQ-0j5sM8u2Xqe58IoOu4GB-rRwOYLsgJBftXxMDcYjNl4noPT5i_rBh-mYsEqb2ExCsZQD58huPP4c61KoCUYcBwE3YHs-mrG-xON3ipQ2jBiHvV8oRbwJjF9fbxsO_BQHTMqEa7FtxpWmhZPo29VsSGCF3KE8Y0Yez8DEa_fg7Z25pyL-3resrHVATis1wJKhib8MJlewZEDNNj3rRaHvFgIkBjdR9pFt9TVHfFfcZL15YGzZ8j3XBAt214IeumKmOVfwPEZ-6ItHzw1RTmmGUJjfUGnLy8fErjAuaoMu6t0WxvdpxO57Flv9f0vpwsHa_UFcyRcrNTK2h-NdHVL2V7w2iys0KHX9-ek4LleXIPc_GpblbehzzjTZxbM0nLI1qDPteIoyFlrB9n9nUHOMA0k1EbEoZzGzqsmMWdKispa59ISkQyNId87m62_t2KSs2dxTC5VF5emwDHz1fKw8tpmqghYNYtIuaC6As2HLxpQ5qUv1FZzk7jnLCAkTfx37AwLc3kXTNUTbE8qQm8E1ow2m87iNE-T4wq16tVhsgmk3xHmAoCMDp4NZDh7kM1FOB4hszR77_j10_XMcw9nRg26NjrC9DDcxP5YNfcN_Jf-XRqGthQslq-CWvy-ai3G2Ly5y7OXWpPwaFwhMTvwn0FbTx7TBkRWbsS4X8ojWuIZy2EozuIRvKDg3KKyLhk9Oi2HogA%3D%3D)
---
Peter,
"Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. Nobody was helping. In her words, she was flabbergasted and lost, terrified for her daughter, with no idea what to do next.
**That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for.**
We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting.
Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home.
**Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse.**
I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare.
You can likely count on one hand the number of nonprofits in this country that actually go hands-on – that physically go in and bring a child out. Most cannot.
**The backbone of Heroes for Humanity is veteran special operators trained to find people who do not want to be found, anywhere in the world.** We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families.
"Abby" is one story among many. We recovered **9 children in California in 2023** , identified more than **8 trafficked children** in our work last year, and brought home **three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas** this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered.
_And trafficking is only one front._ The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth.
**Precision rescue, humanitarian aid, and the hope of Jesus Christ. That is the whole of who we are.**
---
---
**My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments, writing to you as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. **We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work in the trenches that most organizations cannot.
[ **I’d like to ask you to directly support these critical efforts, but I also want to pull back the curtain a bit to share with you exactly how this all works.** ](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=53dd8fc496b9411881b20a7046552159&_e=sMIGKUB1nUhNmTQ-0j5sM8u2Xqe58IoOu4GB-rRwOYLsgJBftXxMDcYjNl4noPT5i_rBh-mYsEqb2ExCsZQD58huPP4c61KoCUYcBwE3YHs-mrG-xON3ipQ2jBiHvV8oRbwJjF9fbxsO_BQHTMqEa7FtxpWmhZPo29VsSGCF3KE8Y0Yez8DEa_fg7Z25pyL-3resrHVATis1wJKhib8MJlewZEDNNj3rRaHvFgIkBjdR9pFt9TVHfFfcZL15YGzZgZPbBt5K20PJokZnxjBhAKifu640S87ngd5mtPaZJid0Q9uO78AqNW48swz60EP3O9zMN4ajxN43x6Kl0cAMVu9ZPbORyFqyyadPFS6B6G1spWDaIQp5ust-8arPzdbPuHQkVOcz2IVQELbPF68MDrAKgcpNhxY_Rzp4EvhRpszRPsN5cgXO6_S38GnvRyfr_ybT4DQ5eJT06KdgS38N3tNpXnmxKK0PyslyJWkn-CpQpEaulAU8DkUsWJxwjjLx7tWvrdOc_HsAItnGvMuGzIq5m7TWlseXC5VjFhlAuLQh6eqjl3-96HoUC2tK2nJG-n1E9chG9qjeKt1n-3th9-pXuzuFZkjJqltUyQqRqt1sxa5Cba2Hc8K9ruD1X1nCaM0BRYC_KcO6_7XPKlnTRhkMxtQbsGISOkzwya5qo0rlVon-8bXoSl5i_jpZBTHHc3gIo60WSUPEouWrD89sog%3D%3D) We've put together a short video, with an intro from my dear friend Chad Robichaux, that gets into the tactics, the operators, and the full story of how we brought "Abby" home. clean_body: A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. | | | | | | Peter, "Abby" was missing. That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for. We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting. Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home. Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse. I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare. We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families. "Abby" is one story among many. We recovered 9 children in California in 2023 , identified more than 8 trafficked children in our work last year, and brought home three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered. And trafficking is only one front. The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth. You can't make this up.
A reporter recently approached Rob Wittman to ask about Speaker Mike Johnson's plan to cut Social Security and Medicare. Wittman's response? He pulled out his phone and spent over a minute pretending to be on a call — even though his screen was clearly visible and showed no active call.
"Hey, how you doing? I'm good. I'm good with that. I'll be there in just a few minutes."
Talking to nobody. For 70 seconds. Rather than answer a simple question about whether he supports cutting the Social Security benefits that Virginia seniors depend on.
Yes, it's objectively funny. A sitting congressman faking a phone call like a teenager trying to avoid an awkward conversation.
But here's what isn't funny: Speaker Johnson has said he has a plan to "adjust and fix" programs like Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid. That's Washington-speak for cuts. And Rob Wittman — rather than tell his constituents where he stands — literally pretended to talk to someone who wasn't there.
This is the kind of political theater and showmanship that Americans are completely fed up with. Not the phone call itself — though that's embarrassing enough — but what it reveals about who Rob Wittman really is after 18 years in Congress. A politician who will do anything to avoid accountability. Who will dodge, deflect, and deceive rather than stand up and tell the truth.
Mel Tull is running for Congress because VA-01 deserves something completely different.
As Mel recently told a reporter: "My job has been to evaluate competing interests, understand risks and consequences, and help people make sound decisions. I've spent my career bringing people together to solve difficult problems, not score political points."
Just honest, straightforward leadership that puts Virginians first.

### **Thank You for the years of support**
---
**Exhausted Votes are a Feature of Ranked Choice Voting and Jungle Primaries.** **This is how Mary Peltola won in 2022: Two Republicans Splitting the Vote Al Gross was supposed to be in 4th place, but he dropped out (after the deadline).** **The Division of Elections removed his name. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2469%2E259176%2E7jZjNC) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2469%2E259176%2E7jZjNC)_

The Virginia Supreme Court struck down the new congressional map that Virginia voters passed in April. [**So, our race just became even more crucial to our battle for the House Majority. Before I get into my background and how I’m fighting back, will you split a $25 donation to flip VA-02?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.11_Luria-Chutzpah_B3_F1_S19_C19_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=5&akid=2469%2E259176%2E7jZjNC) | [DONATE $25 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.11_Luria-Chutzpah_B3_F1_S19_C19_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=6&akid=2469%2E259176%2E7jZjNC)
---
_Chutzpah_ — is a Yiddish term that means _guts_ or _courage._
In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama.
That took some serious _chutzpah._
My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind.
That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community.
That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed.
In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms.
In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them.
In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous.
In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened.
In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either _can’t_ or _won’t_ protect them.
The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It’s time for action.**
Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. **This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle.**
Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little _mishigas._ And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need.
[**Will you split a $25 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help me win this battleground race and restore America’s promise for ALL?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.11_Luria-Chutzpah_B3_F1_S19_C19_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=7&akid=2469%2E259176%2E7jZjNC)

name: AOC
subject: A big reason I believe the things I do today.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Growing up between The Bronx and Yorktown deeply shaped my views of inequality.
#
I’m proud of how I grew up and talk about it all the time!
My mom cleaned houses and I helped. We cleaned tutors’ homes in exchange for SAT prep.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260611.anvyFH&refcode=em20260611-11666-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=11666%2E2526796%2E-eTr2j)
Growing up between The Bronx and Yorktown deeply shaped my views of inequality and it’s a big reason I believe the things I do today.
When my dad died during the financial crisis, my mom almost got foreclosed on.
The GOP always thinks this is some gotcha but I ran my whole campaign for Congress on this: **your ZIP code shouldn’t determine your destiny.**
Our movement is powered by people who believe the same, that a better world is possible for each and every one of us — and **we’re going to have to push harder than ever this election year**.
That's why we're traveling to red, blue, and purple districts around the country to organize working people.
[Help us continue the fight with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260611.anvyFH&refcode=em20260611-11666-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=11666%2E2526796%2E-eTr2j)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

From dope dealer to hope dealer: Detroit pastor Lorenzo Sewell brings message of redemption to Colorado
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**Freedom Fest is** **just 15 days away** , and Saturday is shaping up to be an incredible day for families across Colorado.
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**[]()**_**[Your $45 ticket includes:](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_ 🐎 Championship Rodeo 🎸 Live concert with country music star Curtis Grimes 🎈 Family Festival featuring inflatables, games, and fun for kids of all ages 🐐 Petting Zoo 🎨 Face Painting 🍔 Food Trucks and Festival Vendors 🤝 Candidate Meet & Greet
And that's all before a day of amazing speakers featuring Greg Gutfeld, Dr. James Lindsay, Lee Habeeb, our Colorado congressional reps, and more! Cap off the weekend at the Mountain Majesty Gala featuring Secretary of Energy Chris Wright, Nick Shirley, Larry Gatlin, and our spectacular Drone Show Finale.
If you're looking for a fun family day this summer, Freedom Fest is it. _**Tickets start at just $45.**_
**[June 26-27 | Douglas County Fairgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
🎟️ **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[]()**This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, June 11, 2026.
– Team RMV
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[From dope dealer to hope dealer: Detroit pastor Lorenzo Sewell brings message of redemption to Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
He walked into church on April 18, 1999, with a bruised brow, money in his pocket, and murder on his mind. By the time he walked out, Lorenzo Sewell had given his life to Christ. That same day he went to his drug boss and quit.
That day, and that decision, is the foundation of everything Sewell has built since.
The senior pastor of 180 Church in Detroit will bring his story of redemption and his message of civic faith to the RMV Freedom Fest, where he will speak on the main stage and give the invocation at the Mountain Majesty Gala on Saturday, June 27.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Be part of history at Freedom Festival 2026.** Celebrate America’s 250th and Colorado’s 150th with with 2000+ patriots: two unforgettable days of speakers, action, community, and FUN for the whole family at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. _America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once._ Secure your tickets now and be part of it.
[GET YOUR TICKETS NOW!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[From coal transition to data centers: JOLT summit heads to Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **JOLT — Joint Organizations Leading Transition — was founded by local officials in communities like Craig and Moffat County grappling with what coal's decline would mean for property taxes, jobs, and county budgets:** this year's summit covers geothermal, data centers, critical minerals, nuclear, workforce development, and Colorado River issues, with U.S. Interior Associate Deputy Secretary Karen Budd-Falen as keynote.
* **Coal remains part of the conversation:** federal officials recently ordered Craig Unit 1 to stay online past its planned retirement date to maintain grid reliability in the West — underscoring JOLT chairman Ray Beck's view that coal still provides dependable baseload power and that diversification, not elimination, is the smart approach.
* **Beck argues nuclear deserves far more attention as a reliable, affordable energy source:** and frames the broader mission simply — "energy is economic development," providing jobs, property taxes, and community services that state and local governments depend on, which is why JOLT refuses to pick winners and losers among energy sources.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Colorado grew on a wave. The wave is gone.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 9** _Colorado crossed six million people in 2025, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. Headlines called it a milestone. What they didn’t report is how the state got there, and what’s left now that the wave behind the growth has receded._
**[Colorado calls its elections a model. Mark Cook says voters have lost oversight of them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | JUNE 8** _Colorado’s top election officials call the state’s voting system a national model. Secretary of State Jena Griswold has described it as the “gold standard,” pointing to first-in-the-nation risk-limiting audits, bipartisan checks and ballot tracking. Mark Cook argues that the people the system is supposed to answer to — voters, and the county clerks closest to them — have lost meaningful oversight of how it runs._
**[Property taxes up, TABOR refunds nearly gone: El Paso County data reveals the real cost of Colorado’s tax system](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 8** _The first-half property tax payment is due every year by the end of February. The number on the front has gone up again. Somewhere near the bottom, a small credit appears: “TABOR credit.”_

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).
|

We know you're tired.
Tired of watching billionaires rig the rules while working families fall further behind. Tired of elected officials who talk a big game and fold the moment it gets hard. Tired of a government that seems to work for everyone except the people it's supposed to serve.
You've been showing up anyway. Donating. Knocking doors. Staying engaged when it would be so much easier to tune out. And it has not gone unnoticed.
That's exactly why Equal Opportunity Now was created.
Founded by Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi, Equal Opportunity Now was built on a simple belief: that opportunity isn't guaranteed — it has to be fought for. Every American deserves a shot.
We're not here to back the same tired playbook. We're here to find and support a different kind of leader — and we think you know exactly who we're talking about.
The ones who didn't grow up with connections or family money. The ones who know what it means to stretch a paycheck, navigate a broken system, or fight for a seat at a table that wasn't built for them. The ones who've been told to wait their turn and decided not to.
Leaders who won't flinch when the attacks come. Who believe in getting results now instead of peddling more rhetoric. Who show up every single day because they actually believe government can work for the people — because they've lived what happens when it doesn't.
Those leaders and causes are out there right now. In city councils and state legislatures and community organizations across this country. Waiting for someone to bet on them early. Waiting for the resources and the infrastructure to turn their fight into something real.
That's what your support makes possible.
When you give to Equal Opportunity Now, you're not just writing a check. You're helping build the bench of fighters this country desperately needs — leaders who will take on Trump's MAGA agenda and build something better for working families on the other side.

That's exactly why Equal Opportunity Now was created. Founded by Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi, Equal Opportunity Now was built on a simple belief: that opportunity isn't guaranteed — it has to be fought for. Every American deserves a shot. We're not here to back the same tired playbook. We're here to find and support a different kind of leader — and we think you know exactly who we're talking about. | Peter,

With just two days before early voting begins, an outside group has launched a **$500,000** ad buy to bail out my primary opponent.

Projects** _– The New York Times, 5/27/26_
---
Donald Trump is taking **over $67 million** in fees paid by visitors to national parks across the country to fund repairs on ten of Washington’s ornamental fountains and water features.
**All while our cherished public lands suffer from understaffing, deteriorating roads, and ever-increasing maintenance backlogs _that threaten visitor safety._**
These are the kinds of decisions that truly pain my heart. For so many people, our national parks are where we reconnect with the natural world — where we remember what is worth protecting.
To reroute the very funding meant to preserve those places into Trump’s pet projects is a betrayal of that connection.
What Trump doesn’t seem to understand is that our public lands belong to all of us. They hold our memories, our family trips, our photographs, our awe, our quiet moments of peace. And they deserve to be protected.
I know this personally.
**In fact, if our parks system had been this neglected nearly 40 years ago, I might not even be sending you this note today.**
I was hiking deep in Sequoia National Park in 1989 when I got separated from my companion and became lost above the timberline. Night fell. The temperature dropped. I had no choice but to hunker down in the snow until morning.
I was lucky: The Forest Service sent a helicopter to search for me the next morning. But if our parks system had been as cruelly underfunded and understaffed back then as it is today, my story might have ended very differently.
It’s this very corruption and neglect that drove me to start my climate PAC.
**The only real, lasting answer to a federal government that won’t protect us is to elect leaders at every level who _will_.** State legislators. Attorneys general. Members of Congress with the courage to stand up to a president who is weaponizing the Oval Office to weaken our institutions and help Big Polluters turn a profit.
And it’s up to us to put a stop to it.
✊ In solidarity,
xx Jane
Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. clean_body: Another reason why we do this work | = I haven’t been able to stop thinking about this news story: | National Park Entrance Fees Are Funding Trump’s D.C. Projects – The New York Times, 5/27/26 Donald Trump is taking over $67 million in fees paid by visitors to national parks across the country to fund repairs on ten of Washington’s ornamental fountains and water features. All while our cherished public lands suffer from understaffing, deteriorating roads, and ever-increasing maintenance backlogs that threaten visitor safety. These are the kinds of decisions that truly pain my heart. For so many people, our national parks are where we reconnect with the natural world — where we remember what is worth protecting. To reroute the very funding meant to preserve those places into Trump’s pet projects is a betrayal of that connection. What Trump doesn’t seem to understand is that our public lands belong to all of us. They hold our memories, our family trips, our photographs, our awe, our quiet moments of peace. And they deserve to be protected. I know this personally. In fact, if our parks system had been this neglected nearly 40 years ago, I might not even be sending you this note today. I was hiking deep in Sequoia National Park in 1989 when I got separated from my companion and became lost above the timberline. Night fell. The temperature dropped. I had no choice but to hunker down in the snow until morning. I was lucky: The Forest Service sent a helicopter to search for me the next morning. But if our parks system had been as cruelly underfunded and understaffed back then as it is today, my story might have ended very differently. It’s this very corruption and neglect that drove me to start my climate PAC. The only real, lasting answer to a federal government that won’t protect us is to elect leaders at every level who will. State legislators. Attorneys general. Members of Congress with the courage to stand up to a president who is weaponizing the Oval Office to weaken our institutions and help Big Polluters turn a profit. And it’s up to us to put a stop to it. ✊ In solidarity, xx Jane Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. **** The Trump administration released another rule stating that Medicaid recipients exempted from the employment requirements must prove every **six months** that they are still too medically frail to work. **This is ridiculous and dangerous for patients who rely on this coverage.****** That means someone with cancer may lose their coverage, and the illness could progress from Stage 1 to Stage 4 in the blink of an eye. This is just another burden to push on to patients who are too medically frail to work. **Patients who suffer from illnesses like cancer or sickle cell will be punished for just being unlucky enough to be ill.****** It’s absolutely ridiculous. clean_body: | | | Trump believes those with stage four cancer must work. The Trump administration released another rule stating that Medicaid recipients exempted from the employment requirements must prove every six months that they are still too medically frail to work. This is ridiculous and dangerous for patients who rely on this coverage.**** That means someone with cancer may lose their coverage, and the illness could progress from Stage 1 to Stage 4 in the blink of an eye. This is just another burden to push on to patients who are too medically frail to work. Patients who suffer from illnesses like cancer or sickle cell will be punished for just being unlucky enough to be ill.**** It’s absolutely ridiculous. Advocacy groups, such as the American Lung Association and AIDS United, plan to fight back against this rule, but we need a new BLUE Congress to fight against the Trump administration’s arbitrary rules. Able Dems is fighting to elect new Democratic members who will fight against these immoral rules.**** ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. **Aaron Ford just won the Democratic nomination for Governor of Nevada, and I am proud to stand behind him.**
If you are with me in this fight to flip Nevada blue and support leaders pushing back against Trump’s agenda in the midterm elections, please use this link to help Aaron get his general election campaign off to a strong start: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_af_20260611_1_ak](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260611_1_ak.mJk6FB&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-280&t=3&akid=284%2E127862%2ES3MiJG)**

body:
The screenshot says it all. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133157734/626910778/-785282667?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2ZhMGEzNS1jZDY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qETKvwHD-jfap-33W9ctKxTRdqMOvNE1E6bStmuksUk=)

Peter, **It’s rare you hear from me 2 days in a row, but yesterday, I told you about the fake AI-generated ad my Republican opponent released using my likeness, my image, and a synthetic version of my voice.** **Since then, this has only gotten bigger.** Local outlets are covering it. I went on Morning Joe this morning to sound the alarm. And people across Vermont and across the country are starting to pay attention because they understand what is at stake here. **Bernie Sanders is speaking out too, and I’m grateful to have my fellow Vermonter in this fight with me. Bernie knows that Vermonters can handle tough debates and honest disagreements. What we should never have to sort through are fake videos, fake voices, and AI-generated lies designed to mislead people.** **This was not just a nasty attack ad. It was an attempt to use AI to impersonate me, put words in my mouth, and confuse voters about what is real and what is not.** **[CLICK HERE TO HELP ME SET THE RECORD STRAIGHT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133157735/626910779/-522538092?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2ZhMGEzNS1jZDY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qETKvwHD-jfap-33W9ctKxTRdqMOvNE1E6bStmuksUk=)** Here is a screenshot from the fake AI-generated video: **If this guy wanted to show voters who he really is, using AI to stage himself talking down to a fake version of a woman he is running against was certainly a choice.** But beyond the absurdity, this is serious. Using AI to impersonate a candidate and deceive voters is dangerous, and it is exactly why we need real accountability for AI-generated political content. And I am going to keep saying this clearly: Free speech is a cornerstone of our democracy, but impersonation and deception are not. **[HELP ME KEEP FIGHTING BACK TODAY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133157736/626910780/-522538092?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2ZhMGEzNS1jZDY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qETKvwHD-jfap-33W9ctKxTRdqMOvNE1E6bStmuksUk=)** **I am grateful that so many people stepped up yesterday. Really. It meant a lot to know that this team understood the seriousness of this moment right away.** Fake content spreads fast. Lies travel quickly. And when someone uses AI to fabricate a candidate’s voice and image, the truth has to reach people just as forcefully and just as quick. **That takes resources. And we’re still working on that.** We need to communicate directly with voters. We need to make sure Vermonters know exactly what happened. We need to push back everywhere this fake attack is circulating. And we need to make clear that AI-generated impersonations have no place in our elections. [_**So I’m asking today, because this moment demands it: Will you consider clicking here and chipping in to help my campaign keep fighting back and make sure the truth does not get drowned out by these AI-generated lies?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133157737/626910781/-522538092?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2ZhMGEzNS1jZDY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qETKvwHD-jfap-33W9ctKxTRdqMOvNE1E6bStmuksUk=) Voters should not also have to wonder whether the candidate they are seeing on screen is real, or whether the words they are hearing were ever actually said. That is the danger here. **And that is exactly why I introduced the NO FAKES Act: to give people protections against unauthorized AI replicas of their voice and likeness, and to bring greater transparency and accountability to AI-generated content.** What happened to me was offensive. It was deceptive. And it was predictable. And if we do not act now, this will happen again. To me, to other candidates, and to voters who are just trying to figure out what is true. **I refuse to let that become normal.** [_**If you do too, please consider chipping in today to help me keep pushing back, defend the truth, and make sure Vermonters hear directly from me.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133157738/626910782/-522538092?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2ZhMGEzNS1jZDY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qETKvwHD-jfap-33W9ctKxTRdqMOvNE1E6bStmuksUk=) Today is about whether the truth still matters in our elections. **I believe it does. I believe voters deserve better than fake voices, fake videos, and manufactured lies. And I’m going to keep fighting like hell to make sure the truth wins here.** Thanks for standing with me, — Becca

Direction of the Democrats**

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE June 11th, 2026****CONTACT karina@nhrsc.com**
CONCORD, N.H. — After Graham Platner secured a victory in the Maine Democratic Senate primary, serious questions are being raised about the direction of the Democratic Party.
Platner’s campaign has been no stranger to controversy with headlines exposing his multiple text scandals, several serious allegations of his volatile and demeaning behavior towards women, having a Nazi tattoo, and then him saying a U.S. soldier “didn’t deserve to live” after being shot by the Taliban four times.
Despite these revelations, Platner secured the Democratic primary nomination and will now serve as his party’s nominee in one of the nation's most closely watched Senate races.“This is the Democratic Party of 2026,” said Scott Maltzie, Chairman of the New Hampshire Republican State Committee. “No leader, no message, and embracing the far left wing of the Democratic Party. This is who they are. Their candidates refuse to condemn what is obviously alarming.”

Peter,
Gina just launched Team Texas Public Schools. A new bipartisan organizing program designed to engage parents, teachers, and administrators — regardless of party — to fight school closures across the state.

name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: They charged him with a felony for stopping a riot
body:
Dear Patriot,
They charged a cop with a felony for stopping a riot. I am not making this up.
They want to lock him away for using **non-lethal bean bag rounds** against a violent mob that was blocking an interstate highway, hurling rocks at officers, and bringing Molotov cocktails to the party.
I have seen a lot in my years in law enforcement. I have seen politics poison the justice system. But what is being done to Officer Jeffrey Teng of Austin, Texas is one of the most shameless, stomach-turning betrayals of law enforcement I have ever witnessed.
** [It has to stop — and I need your help to stop it.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=489487489bf24c6f9e100927c644e3a3&_e=q7eMd_1Lmz38erBHp_zjCA2Zay1gp3fji76DZ-LsI03YsUzObQDTPjmEAurezg6u661Zy8xNtMxKF10KwuJxiFJ1SDYIPv0LWLj-XthDhs037AjRPAHAYRSZxZjziWoe6MilVZed0SC9UqIthKE3ONsao2Q5c8pCff0R0WHS8Nh7sKcuDBcSQJ6IoaGvE1byvoRpKLr-IBZcWXt5NxrwHEspWcPL4J2GpIYQnK0-BRd9WCrAQdtR8Eij5EHZX5JJ3wEVWNfpjsId3spH45bStpOC1AjP4YW-q8TPqjAnk-UgHq8Q0SiHN70DFLBQ4RR16YDsMXPaM8B02FuwzineuPMJtUkSo8NitpXTpv8UMPlnz60TFN4vp8ftLTfzcjuZBxay-BcSJMzFwAMg0RjlR2P8m9XnE7mYQ1eEdKLLn9hGRtNcXMNOUPycCfVrA7in) **
It was Memorial Day weekend, 2020. Hundreds of protesters flooded the streets of Austin. What started as a demonstration turned into three days of chaos: buildings looted, police vehicles set on fire, a rioter caught with a Molotov cocktail before he could throw it. It took nearly Austin's entire 2,100-officer police force to keep the city from total collapse.
On May 31st, a mob completely shut down I-35 — a major interstate highway — directly in front of police headquarters. Ambulances couldn't get through. Officers gave verbal orders to disperse. A police helicopter broadcast commands over a loudspeaker. The rioters refused.
**Officer Jeffrey Teng and his partner were ordered in to clear the highway.**
Officer Jeffrey Teng with his wife
When they arrived, the mob started throwing rocks. One of those rocks struck Officer Teng's partner square in the chest. Under attack, outnumbered, doing their jobs — Teng and his fellow officers deployed non-lethal rounds to stop the violence.
That's it. That's the "crime."
Now Jeffrey Teng, along with 4 other Austin police officers, faces felony charges. Meanwhile, District Attorney José Garza has dismissed nearly every charge against the actual rioters. The people who threw rocks, set cars on fire, and shut down a highway walk free. The officers who stopped them are being prosecuted.
This is a political vendetta by a DA who has made it his mission to destroy the men and women who keep order in our streets.

name: Burt Jones
subject: Why Would Rick Jackson Lie About Kemp’s Endorsement?
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
BURT JONES FOR GEORGIA INC
body:
He's scared voters will find out about his record. |
---

Peter,

Rick Jackson started this campaign lying about the Trump endorsement and **he's ending it lying about the Kemp endorsement.**

Why? Because he's scared voters will find out about his record.

Governor Kemp has been crystal clear: **he has not endorsed anybody**. Yet Jackson has been out there using Kemp's name to mislead Georgia voters. It's dishonest, it's desperate, and frankly, it's exactly what we've come to expect from Rick Jackson.

Georgia can see exactly who Rick Jackson is and no amount of money can bury the truth.

As we celebrate Pride, we also mourn and remember beloved Black trans women in and near Detroit whose lives were tragically cut short in recent years due to violence:
Tahiry Broom (29), Karmin Wells (25), Christina Hayes (38), Ashia Davis (34), Naomie Skinner (25), Dede Ricks (33), Hayden Davis (28), and Natasha Keianna (37)
Black trans women led protests across the country in the 1950s and 1960s, up through the 1969 Stonewall uprising, which inspired the first Pride march. In very hostile times, Black trans women have fought for and won progress that has benefited us all. The rest of us need to be an ally and fight for them.
The Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention has warned that our country is in the middle of a genocide against transgender people, especially with the Trump administration’s escalating attacks against trans people’s very existence.

clean_body: I’ll always fight to protect your rights, safety, and ability to live freely and authentically. | | | Friend, Happy Pride Month! I got to join Detroit’s Pride parade last weekend: If you’re LGBTQI+, I want you to know that you matter, you belong here, and I will keep fighting for you in Congress. With increasing attacks on transgender people in particular, those of us who are allies must be loud, unapologetic, and persistent in creating a world where trans people are safe and welcomed as their authentic selves. At the federal level, I’ve introduced the Justice For All Act to expand civil rights laws, including protecting people from intentional and unintentional discrimination that’s based on their gender identity or sexual orientation. I’m also speaking out against anti-trans attacks and cosponsoring policies like the Transgender Health Care Access Act , the Trans Bill of Rights , the Equality Act , and the Pride in Mental Health Act . The Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention has warned that our country is in the middle of a genocide against transgender people, so we must urgently expand nationwide protections for our trans and queer siblings. | Thank you for taking action, and please continue doing so throughout Pride Month and beyond! With you in the fight for equity and dignity for all, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Wed, Jun 10, 2026 Subject: Take action for trans people this Pride Month: To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Happy Pride, friend! Last weekend, I got to join Motor City Pride, and I was so filled with joy to hear my neighbors thanking my team and me for fighting for them. LGBTQI+ people, I’ve got your back. I’ll always fight in Congress to protect your rights, your safety, and your ability to live freely and authentically. That includes speaking out against transphobia, holding and participating in hearings about issues facing the LGBTQI+ community, being part of the Equality Caucus, and securing federal funding for groups in my district that support LGBTQI+ people. I’m also cosponsoring policies like the Transgender Health Care Access Act , the Trans Bill of Rights , the Pride in Mental Health Act , and the Equality Act. And my Justice For All Act would expand civil rights laws, including making sure that people are protected from intentional and unintentional discrimination that’s based on their gender identity or sexual orientation. Passing these changes into law would override many of Trump’s and state leaders’ dangerous attacks on our trans siblings. As we celebrate Pride, we also mourn and remember beloved Black trans women in and near Detroit whose lives were tragically cut short in recent years due to violence: Tahiry Broom (29), Karmin Wells (25), Christina Hayes (38), Ashia Davis (34), Naomie Skinner (25), Dede Ricks (33), Hayden Davis (28), and Natasha Keianna (37) Black trans women led protests across the country in the 1950s and 1960s, up through the 1969 Stonewall uprising, which inspired the first Pride march. In very hostile times, Black trans women have fought for and won progress that has benefited us all. The rest of us need to be an ally and fight for them. The Lemkin Institute for Genocide Prevention has warned that our country is in the middle of a genocide against transgender people, especially with the Trump administration’s escalating attacks against trans people’s very existence. We must all get louder in the fight for trans people’s rights and lives. Thank you. Please keep taking action during Pride Month and beyond, especially if you’re an ally who’s not part of the LGBTQI+ community. Our solidarity is particularly needed now. Together, let’s continue to demand dignity and safety for Black trans women, as well as all trans, intersex, gender nonconforming, and queer people. In solidarity, Rashida P.S. Here are some resources for allies who want to learn more or do more to support LGBTQI+ people: Trans Lifeline’s The Trevor Project’s to supporting transgender and nonbinary young people and on creating safer spaces in schools for LGBTQI+ young people from Advocates for Trans Equality to frequently asked questions about trans people Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . clean_body: All seven of our endorsed Congressional candidates won or advanced in their primaries. | | | Peter, My name is Jorge Contreras, and I’m the California State Director for the Working Families Party. I wanted to take a moment to talk a bit more about the historic election night we just had, and why the billionaire class has reason to be afraid. For years, California WFP has worked hard to build our party all across the state. We’ve recruited candidates, trained organizers, and built inroads with local leadership. All for the purpose of electing candidates who are willing to take on corporate interests and fight for working people. Now, all that hard work is paying off. All five of our endorsed Congressional candidates won or advanced in their primaries. And further down the ballot, another 54 are advancing to the general election in November. These are true working class leaders — people who understand that working families have been left behind by politicians in both parties, and will stop at nothing to fix that. If we're going to elect even more working-class fighters, we NEED to keep building local power all over the country. The time and money that’s spent on organizing in communities, recruiting candidates, and developing local leaders is a challenge all on its own. And then we have to compete with millions of dollars from corporate interests, super PACs, and MAGA-billionaires too. They’ll stop at nothing to slow us down. Because while the affordability crisis is a matter of life and death for working families, it’s an investment opportunity for the rich and wealthy donors who bankroll our current political system. When gas hits $4, $5, or $6 a gallon, they make a fortune. When the price of eggs, milk, and other groceries double overnight, they make a fortune. When rent prices and mortgage rates skyrocket, they make a fortune. It doesn’t have to be this way. When we elect working-class champions to office,working families win. But it’ll take all of us pulling together to make it happen. In solidarity, Jorge Contreras Interim State Director California Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. name: David Seligman
subject: I met renters who are being pushed to the brink

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q2?refcode=x_260611_rentersrights_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q2?refcode=x_260611_rentersrights_act]
I recently had the opportunity to sit down with renters to hear directly about their struggle to stay in the city they love.
And one thing was crystal clear: living in Colorado shouldn’t be a luxury. Everyone deserves the chance to thrive here, not just scrape by while corporate landlords cash in.
I talked with a guy named David (great name, by the way), who told me he’s paying nearly $3,000 a month for an apartment that wasn’t close to what he was promised.
His landlord told him he would have an additional room and a deck that never got built. Instead, he’s stuck paying more every month than a mortgage for a place that feels, in his words, “like a scam.”
What stuck with me most was when he told me, “They think they have all the power, but they don’t. They’re counting on us not having the time or resources to fight back.”
He’s right.
For too long, corporate landlords and private equity giants have treated renters like they’re powerless, trapping families in unsafe housing, sneaking illegal junk fees into leases, and raising rents while ignoring the law.
I’ll create a Safe Housing Conditions Strike Force that responds within 24 hours to renters living in dangerous or uninhabitable conditions. I’ll take on corporate monopolies buying up Colorado housing. And I’ll use every tool available to hold abusive landlords accountable.
Because the law should protect working people, not just wealthy corporations that exploit them.
But with my primary approaching at the end of this month, I need your help to keep building the grassroots movement we'll need to win this fight.
Can you chip in today to help us stand up for renters across Colorado and put the law back in the hands of the people? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q2?refcode=x_260611_rentersrights_act]

The FIFA World Cup has officially kicked off and what arrives with it is unlike anything this country has faced before.
Every year, the Super Bowl is the single largest magnet for human trafficking in the United States. One city, one weekend, tens of thousands of men concentrated in a few square miles.
The demand for commercial sex explodes overnight, and the children and women already trapped in trafficking situations pay the heaviest price.
**Now imagine that same explosion of exploitation stretched across an entire summer, in city after city, with no end in sight until late July.**
The World Cup runs for over a month across 16 cities. 78 matches hosted here in the U.S., all in NFL-scale stadiums, with millions of spectators descending from around the world. **The scale of exploitation this creates is something we have never seen before in this country, and the clock is already running.**
**Heroes for Humanity is deploying now, boots on the ground, working as a quick reaction force alongside trusted local partners, going wherever we're needed most.** We are one of only a handful of groups in this country that goes hands-on to physically bring young girls and women out of trafficking situations. Many of them former special forces, our operators were trained to find people who do not want to be found, and these are the skills and experience we utilize to rescue these victims.

It spans more than a month, covers multiple cities, and every resource we have goes directly toward keeping our teams in the field and our operators ready to move. Are you with me?

| | | | | | | | | | | My grandpa served in WWII.

My dad served as an Army Green Beret in the Vietnam War.

I was a Navy Helicopter pilot.

I’m married to a Ret. Navy pilot.

And now, I’m a proud Navy mom, too.

Peter, service isn’t just important to me – _it’s in my blood._

That’s why I decided to find a way to serve after my military career was done. I used my GI benefits to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner and take care of the Greatest Generation.

Now, as a Congresswoman, I am still prioritizing care for our veterans. I have never, ever turned my back on my fellow veterans, and they deserve the best care our country has to offer.

_Unfortunately, the values of honor and integrity have gone completely missing in the Democrat Party, and they’re spreading lies that I don’t care about veterans –**Can you believe how low they’ve stooped?**_

My life has been shaped by service to our country, but I need you to have my back here.

subject: Healthy meals fuel healthy minds
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jahana Hayes
body:
This is exactly the work I was sent to Washington to do. | | Hi Friend, A good meal can change the entire school day for a child. Healthy eating fuels the brain, and it leads to improved academic performance and stronger emotional well-being. That is why, as Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Nutrition and Foreign Agriculture, I introduced the _Scratch Cooked Meals for Students Act_ — bipartisan legislation alongside Congresswoman Julia Brownley and Congressman Brian Fitzpatrick. Our bill would create a competitive grant program at the U.S. Department of Agriculture to expand scratch cooking in schools. It would provide _$20 million_ each year from 2027 through 2031 to help schools train cafeteria staff, purchase kitchen equipment, cover the labor of cooking from scratch, and source whole ingredients. Scratch cooking allows districts to prepare more of their own meals using locally sourced ingredients rather than pre-assembled or processed foods. It uses a farm-to-table approach that reduces water, carbon, and waste footprints, and it strengthens local partnerships with farmers and producers. It is a comprehensive way to build healthy eating habits early — habits students can carry well into adulthood. [_**This is exactly the work I was sent to Washington to do. But I cannot keep doing it without you. clean_body: This is exactly the work I was sent to Washington to do. | | Hi Friend, A good meal can change the entire school day for a child. Healthy eating fuels the brain, and it leads to improved academic performance and stronger emotional well-being. That is why, as Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Nutrition and Foreign Agriculture, I introduced the Scratch Cooked Meals for Students Act — bipartisan legislation alongside Congresswoman Julia Brownley and Congressman Brian Fitzpatrick. Our bill would create a competitive grant program at the U.S. Department of Agriculture to expand scratch cooking in schools. It would provide $20 million each year from 2027 through 2031 to help schools train cafeteria staff, purchase kitchen equipment, cover the labor of cooking from scratch, and source whole ingredients. Scratch cooking allows districts to prepare more of their own meals using locally sourced ingredients rather than pre-assembled or processed foods. It uses a farm-to-table approach that reduces water, carbon, and waste footprints, and it strengthens local partnerships with farmers and producers. | |

# [I love this part](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=201596449&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAxNTk2NDQ5LCJpYXQiOjE3ODEyMTE5NzUsImV4cCI6MTc4MzgwMzk3NSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.vYI2lVF9ZKPYpmaQITTMY8_WAhkHupmCc6a0ZlfbfMI)
### Some photos and moments from life on the campaign trail
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 11
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL2ktbG92ZS10aGlzLXBhcnQ_.nguOr04nS-QmbZpt8JXhuX1Q0WlhH-eq8bJIB6joy5E?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/i-love-this-part?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

There are parts of a campaign that can feel a bit unnatural, or uncomfortable, or even weird. Like when you see yourself on TV, or wear a new jacket, or say something with your Michigan accent and everyone on the internet has strong opinions about it.
But then there is the thing I love. The thing that gets me so jazzed in the morning and keeps me going all day. The thing that this work is all about: Talking to Michiganders.
This is the part of the campaign where I get to connect with folks, hear about their lives, and tell them what I'm about. And I have to say, it doesn't get much better than this. I love Michigan, and this campaign is a love letter to this state. Every day I get to be with Michiganders is another page of that letter.
I wanted to share some pics from life on the trail. I hope you enjoy seeing these half as much as I did taking them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We started with a picnic.
UA Local 85 - the plumbers, steamfitters, and HVACR service techs - put on their annual labor picnic, and nobody does a summer cookout like a union family. Lots of laughs, grills going, everyone catching up over a cold pop. I talked with all sorts of folks, and I could feel it in my bones in every conversation: Strong unions make Michigan work.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then I spent a day shopping local in Grand Rapids where I met Myleka. Myleka owns Brooklyn Bodega Bagel & Deli. We talked about what it actually takes to keep a small business going - the early mornings, the supplier costs, the math you run in your head every night before bed. My mom and dad did that same math at our kitchen table for years while running their landscaping business. When Myleka talked, I knew exactly what she meant.
And the bagels, for the record, are incredible.
West Michigan kept the warm welcomes coming! I got to start a morning alongside former Governor O'Malley, Congresswoman Scholten, and Commissioner Hennessy - and a room full of folks who showed up early and asked great questions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Everywhere I went this week, I heard versions of the same thing: Groceries cost too much, gas prices are bonkers, health care costs are freaking people out, and everyone is wondering why they are barely scraping by while busting their tails. It's insane. I get it.
Folks aren't seeing their wages keep up, and the bottom line is people are struggling. And here's the thing: Michiganders aren't asking for anything fancy. They just want to be able to live and they want a government that works. It's actually pretty simple.
That is the whole reason I'm in this race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And then there's my new favorite campaign photo.
At one of our stops, I met a little girl who decided the right move was to give us her best Rosie the Riveter. I loved it.
The fight for Michigan has no age requirement. I'm running for the U.S. Senate to be a champion for every Michigander - the union families at that picnic, Myleka behind her counter serving bagels, the folks who show up early with hard questions, and one very strong little girl whose future in Michigan we need to make sure is full of hope and opportunity.
I had a great weekend out there meeting everyone. I genuinely enjoy talking to folks, and I hope if you see me at any event, you take a moment to come say hi. I want to know what's going on - and what's important to you.
You're the reason I'm doing this. You're who I'm fighting for.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/14cc85fe-0046-4132-a38f-e3e06de3bfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

body:
Meet Matt, Aber, and Evan.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260611-1&t=1&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)
Exciting news, Peter!
**Leaders We Deserve is proud to announce we’re officially endorsing:**
⭐ **Matt Little** for Minnesota CD-2
⭐ **Aber Kawas** for New York SD-12
⭐ **Evan Menist** for New York SD-39
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&refcode=em20260611-3588&t=2&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)
This is our biggest endorsement cycle yet, and our momentum is undeniable. All of these candidates represent the future of the Democratic Party — a healthcare and disability advocate from Lakeville, a Palestinian community organizer from Queens, and a tenant rights fighter from Poughkeepsie. These are leaders that give our generation reasons to hope (and vote!) and prove that fighting for working class communities is the way to win.
**[I’ll tell you more about each of them, but first, will you split a $5 donation between Matt, Aber, Evan and Leaders We Deserve?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&refcode=em20260611-3588&amount=5&t=3&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-3588&t=4&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)**
**Matt Little** was born and raised in Lakeville, and the youngest person ever elected to mayor of the city. He served as a Lakeville City Councilor and state senator, where he led the charge to make sure diabetics could afford insulin, worked to lower prescription drug costs, and expanded Metro Mobility so seniors and people with disabilities had access to public transportation. He currently runs a law firm dedicated to advocating for seniors and people with disabilities who have been neglected or abused, a fight that’s close to home. He knows exactly what it looks like when greedy insurance companies and predatory systems fail the people who need care the most, because he’s watched it happen to the people he loves. And since ICE’s brutality has taken over the streets of Minnesota, he’s been out in the community documenting their actions and tactics so his neighbors know that someone has their back and is paying attention.
In Congress, Matt will fight to lower prescription drug costs and protect Medicaid and Medicare from Trump’s devastating cuts. He’ll invest in infrastructure and clean energy, expand access to mental health services, and take on the corporate greed that has been gutting working families in CD-2 for decades.
Matt is facing a competitive primary, up against two well-funded candidates. His primary is **August 11** , but building a strong pathway to win starts early, and right now is exactly when grassroots support matters most.
**[Split a Donation](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-3588&t=5&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)**
**Aber Kawas** is a community organizer and the daughter of Palestinian refugees who grew up in a working class family in Brooklyn. As a child, she watched her father face deportation — so she knows what ICE’s cruelty looks like firsthand and what happens when they tear families apart. Those experiences molded her into the leader she is today. One that is rooted in an unshakeable resolve for justice and dignity for all people. As a community organizer, she’s been on the frontlines of fights for working class New Yorkers. She helped develop and launch Not On Our Dime alongside Mayor Mamdani, legislation that would stop New York tax dollars from funding Israel’s ongoing genocide of Palestinians. With just two weeks left until her primary, her campaign has already knocked over 11,000 doors across the district.
In the state legislature, Aber will focus on bringing the working class voices of Queens to Albany. She’ll work towards passing the New York Health Act, which would establish single payer healthcare for every New Yorker and cut out the insurance industry’s ability to deny care and price people out of coverage. She’ll push for free and reliable transit, expand affordable housing, and protect immigrant communities from this administration’s vicious attacks.
On the other hand, her opponent in the Democratic primary opposes increased penalties for hate crimes and supports AIPAC. Right now, District 12 has an opportunity to elect a fearless fighter to the state senate who can build on the electric, people-powered momentum Mayor Mamdani has brought to New York. This race is Aber’s to win, she just needs the resources to make sure every voter in her district has a chance to connect with her message before her **June 23** primary.
**[Split a Donation](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-3588&t=6&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)**
**Evan Menist** grew up in a working class union family in New Jersey. He worked his way through college as an IT tech, bartender, and security guard, so he knows firsthand what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck. He has extensive experience, having been a policy researcher and urban planner working with municipalities and organizations across the region. He has also worked in Albany as a staffer for a state senator, giving him key insight into the legislative process. That experience will help him be a strong voice on housing, economic development, and public safety in the state legislature. He’s now in his 4th term on the Poughkeepsie Common Council, where he’s passed Good Cause Eviction legislation to protect tenants from predatory rent increases and unfair evictions and helped secure $8 million for New York’s first Green Social Housing pilot, where housing will be capped at 25% of income.
In Albany, he’ll work to pass statewide rent stabilization through the REST act, build public and social housing, invest in public utilities, universal healthcare and childcare, and fund all of it by making the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share.
Evan faces a competitive primary on **June 23** , and this is a purple seat to flip. But with deep community ties, a strong track record, and the most progressive vision for what District 39 can become, Evan is built to win it.
**[Split a Donation](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-3588&t=7&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)**
Matt, Aber, and Evan don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. Not a single check from anyone trying to buy their vote. **They have something the establishment can’t buy: real roots in the communities they’re fighting for, and the kind of conviction and moral clarity that doesn’t waver when things get hard.**
That’s exactly what makes them the kind of candidates Leaders We Deserve are proud to back. But to take them all the way, they need grassroots support to carry them to victory in their primaries.
**[That’s why I need you to step up today, Peter. Can you split a $5 donation between Matt, Aber, Evan, and Leaders We Deserve today?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260611_1_endorsements.D8pDZp&refcode=em20260611-3588&amount=5&t=8&akid=3588%2E587540%2EAHCbzO)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

He served as a Lakeville City Councilor and state senator, where he led the charge to make sure diabetics could afford insulin, worked to lower prescription drug costs, and expanded Metro Mobility so seniors and people with disabilities had access to public transportation. He currently runs a law firm dedicated to advocating for seniors and people with disabilities who have been neglected or abused, a fight that’s close to home. He knows exactly what it looks like when greedy insurance companies and predatory systems fail the people who need care the most, because he’s watched it happen to the people he loves. And since ICE’s brutality has taken over the streets of Minnesota, he’s been out in the community documenting their actions and tactics so his neighbors know that someone has their back and is paying attention. In Congress, Matt will fight to lower prescription drug costs and protect Medicaid and Medicare from Trump’s devastating cuts. He’ll invest in infrastructure and clean energy, expand access to mental health services, and take on the corporate greed that has been gutting working families in CD-2 for decades. Matt is facing a competitive primary, up against two well-funded candidates. His primary is August 11 , but building a strong pathway to win starts early, and right now is exactly when grassroots support matters most. Aber Kawas is a community organizer and the daughter of Palestinian refugees who grew up in a working class family in Brooklyn. As a child, she watched her father face deportation — so she knows what ICE’s cruelty looks like firsthand and what happens when they tear families apart. Those experiences molded her into the leader she is today. One that is rooted in an unshakeable resolve for justice and dignity for all people. As a community organizer, she’s been on the frontlines of fights for working class New Yorkers. She helped develop and launch Not On Our Dime alongside Mayor Mamdani, legislation that would stop New York tax dollars from funding Israel’s ongoing genocide of Palestinians. With just two weeks left until her primary, her campaign has already knocked over 11,000 doors across the district. In the state legislature, Aber will focus on bringing the working class voices of Queens to Albany. She’ll work towards passing the New York Health Act, which would establish single payer healthcare for every New Yorker and cut out the insurance industry’s ability to deny care and price people out of coverage. She’ll push for free and reliable transit, expand affordable housing, and protect immigrant communities from this administration’s vicious attacks. On the other hand, her opponent in the Democratic primary opposes increased penalties for hate crimes and supports AIPAC. Right now, District 12 has an opportunity to elect a fearless fighter to the state senate who can build on the electric, people-powered momentum Mayor Mamdani has brought to New York. This race is Aber’s to win, she just needs the resources to make sure every voter in her district has a chance to connect with her message before her June 23 primary. Evan Menist grew up in a working class union family in New Jersey. He worked his way through college as an IT tech, bartender, and security guard, so he knows firsthand what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck. He has extensive experience, having been a policy researcher and urban planner working with municipalities and organizations across the region. He has also worked in Albany as a staffer for a state senator, giving him key insight into the legislative process. That experience will help him be a strong voice on housing, economic development, and public safety in the state legislature. He’s now in his 4th term on the Poughkeepsie Common Council, where he’s passed Good Cause Eviction legislation to protect tenants from predatory rent increases and unfair evictions and helped secure $8 million for New York’s first Green Social Housing pilot, where housing will be capped at 25% of income. In Albany, he’ll work to pass statewide rent stabilization through the REST act, build public and social housing, invest in public utilities, universal healthcare and childcare, and fund all of it by making the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share. Evan faces a competitive primary on June 23 , and this is a purple seat to flip. But with deep community ties, a strong track record, and the most progressive vision for what District 39 can become, Evan is built to win it. Matt, Aber, and Evan don’t take a dime from corporate PACs or special interests. Not a single check from anyone trying to buy their vote. They have something the establishment can’t buy: real roots in the communities they’re fighting for, and the kind of conviction and moral clarity that doesn’t waver when things get hard. That’s exactly what makes them the kind of candidates Leaders We Deserve are proud to back. But to take them all the way, they need grassroots support to carry them to victory in their primaries. Thank you, David Hogg
