name: Tom Fitton
subject: We’re Suing California
body:
873,092 dirty voter registrations. That’s how many names are on California’s voter rolls and have been inactive for at least three consecutive federal elections.
| [ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=14409&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=cbf44e67f3ede953fe8e284608b1050d98304e9f4df39ddcd4fb05803b508a8c)
---
Dear Fellow American, **873,092 dirty voter registrations.** That's how many names are on **California** 's voter rolls and have been _inactive for at least three consecutive federal elections_. This is an open invitation for fraud AND a violation of federal law. That's why **Judicial Watch** is _suing_ the state of **California** _(as they STILL are counting ballots from LAST WEEK 's primary elections!)_ for failing to maintain accurate voter rolls as required by federal law. | [HELP CLEAN UP DIRTY VOTER ROLLS ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
The National Voter Registration Act (NVRA) requires most voter registrations to be removed after two inactive general federal elections. But shockingly, over **150,000** California registrations have remained _inactive for FOUR federal elections_ and **tens of thousands** have been _inactive for FIVE OR MORE_. **California is blatantly disregarding federal law, so Judicial Watch is suing to force them into compliance.** _[Will you make a first-time contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_ to help fund our California voter roll lawsuit, along with our broader fight for fair and honest elections? | [FUEL OUR FIGHT FOR CLEAN ELECTIONS ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
Our lawsuit cites _admissions_ by **California** officials that the state takes _no effective action_ to require counties to comply with the NVRA. **And the county-level numbers are outrageous.**
* 20 California counties _removed 50 or fewer inactive voters_ from their rolls between November 2022 and November 2024 despite having over **4 million** registered voters.

* 10 counties reported _ZERO inactive removals_ under the NVRA during the same period.

* 18 counties have _more registered voters than adult citizens_.

For context, over **2.1 million** residents moved out of California between 2022 and 2024. Those numbers alone make it _impossible_ that the state has been making a reasonable effort to maintain accurate voter rolls. **That 's why we're seeking an order _requiring_ the state to implement a _lawful voter-role maintenance_ program. ** | [SUPPORT OUR NVRA LAWSUITS ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
Judicial Watch's lawsuits and legal actions have already led to the **removal of nearly seven million ineligible names** from voter rolls _nationwide_. No organization has done more to clean voter rolls around the country than Judicial Watch, and I'm proud of the **impact** our team has made to promote**faith and confidence** in American elections. We have the leading Election Law _experts_. We have the _experience_. And, we have an unmatched _track record_ of _getting results_. But there is still much work to be done as revealed by our latest NVRA lawsuit in California, and _[I can't stress enough the major resources each lawsuit requires](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_. **We _must_ keep the funding rolling in.** That is why I am asking you to _[help keep the momentum going with a special contribution](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_ to fund our California lawsuit and the rest of Judicial Watch's election integrity litigation. | [DEFEND CLEAN ELECTIONS ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
With _[your support](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83443&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_ , we will keep fighting (and winning!) in court to clean up dirty voter rolls across the nation and defend the rule of law. Sincerely, Tom Fitton

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEJune 11, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**LIVINGSTON PARISH REPUBLICAN EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE ENDORSES JULIA LETLOW FOR U.S. SENATE** _Trump-Endorsed Conservative Earns Backing from Livingston Parish Republican Leaders Ahead of June 27 Runoff_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for United States Senate, announced today that she has earned the endorsement of the Livingston Parish Republican Executive Committee.
The endorsement adds to the growing coalition of Republican leaders, grassroots activists, and conservative organizations supporting Letlow's campaign as she heads into the June 27 runoff election.
_“The members of the Livingston Parish Republican Executive Committee are proud to support Julia Letlow for the United States Senate,”_ **said Jamey Sandefur, Chairman of the Livingston Parish Republican Executive Committee.** _“Julia is a principled conservative, a proven fighter for Louisiana families, and someone we know will stand with President Trump and the America First agenda. We are confident she will be a strong voice for Louisiana in the Senate.”_
_“I'm honored to have the support of the Livingston Parish Republican Executive Committee,”_**said Congresswoman Letlow.**_**** “Livingston Parish has long been a stronghold of conservative values and grassroots leadership in Louisiana. I am grateful for their confidence in our campaign and look forward to continuing our work to advance the America First agenda, stand with President Trump, and fight for the people of Louisiana in the United States Senate.”_
The Livingston Parish Republican Executive Committee joins a broad coalition of conservative leaders and organizations from across Louisiana supporting Letlow's campaign including Governor Jeff Landry, U.S. House Majority Leader Steve Scalise, and Louisiana Senate President Cameron Henry.
Early voting for the Republican Senate runoff begins June 12 and continues through June 20. Election Day is June 27.
Learn more about Congresswoman Letlow’s campaign at [JuliaLetlow.com](https://us.list-manage.com/XKHAUBos60M?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a).

The public conversation around the national debt has reached a new level of intensity. As the national ledger officially surpasses $39.1 trillion, business leaders--including Elon Musk--are sharing perspectives that are catching many people's attention.

In recent commentary this year, Musk highlighted a milestone that has many asking: How does this affect the average American?

Currently, interest payments on the national debt have reached approximately $1 trillion per year . For the first time, the cost of simply "servicing the debt" officially exceeds the entire U.S. military budget.

When interest payments become one of the largest expenses in the federal budget, it can create a "crowding out" effect. This means more tax dollars are used to pay for the past, potentially leaving less for the long-term value of the currency in your pocket.

*These statements reflect individual viewpoints and should be considered as part of a broader conversation regarding our fiscal trajectory.*

Understanding your options in this changing environment could be the first step toward a balanced approach. #### _**[Endless Urgency is always free to read, but this community only grows because people choose to invest in it. Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/1b6eb613-89bb-4274-8fe1-f5c47e34942b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

* * *
Something has been bothering me about the MAGA movement lately. It's not a new thought, but right now it's burning a hole through my chest: the way these men treat women -- especially those closest to them.

There's plenty to be angry about. I could sit here and walk you through how violent and regressive their policy choices towards women are -- how badly they want to restrict their rights and dictate what they do with their bodies. I could talk about the rhetoric men like Andrew Tate and Nick Fuentes use to describe women. But today I want to talk about the physical abuse, because this movement does absolutely nothing to protect its own women. Nothing for their wives, their sisters, their daughters. And it disgusts me.

A few stories from the last couple of weeks have been gnawing at me.

Congressman Max Miller of Ohio stands accused by his ex-wife -- the daughter of Senator Bernie Moreno -- of beating her and throwing a pot of boiling water on her. He denies it, but a recording he himself leaked to the press has him acknowledging "the water incident". And nobody in the Republican Party will say a word, because Max Miller is close to Donald Trump, and they cannot afford to upset their king.

Ryan Fournier, the co-founder of Students for Trump, was just arrested again on domestic violence charges -- his second accusation of assaulting a woman in less than two years. Police say he punched a woman in the face and asked her, "Do you want to die today?" The movement's response? Nothing.

The hypocrisy isn't subtle anymore. It's the whole movement.
* * *

Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/1b6eb613-89bb-4274-8fe1-f5c47e34942b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/1b6eb613-89bb-4274-8fe1-f5c47e34942b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
The same people who spend every waking hour talking about protecting women suddenly lose their voices when the accused is one of their own.
And this isn't an isolated problem. The movement keeps producing the same kind of men because it keeps rewarding the same behavior. Andrew Tate built an empire teaching young men that women are property. Nick Fuentes built a following telling men that women should have less freedom and less power. These aren't fringe figures. They're the product.

That brings me to the story of Lauren Southern. She wasn't some liberal feminist critic of Andrew Tate. She was one of the most famous female conservative activists of the last decade -- a woman who built her brand rejecting feminism, a "darling" of the manosphere. Last year she went public: Tate targeted her through right-wing political circles, brought her to Romania under the pretense of discussing a media project, and raped and strangled her. She stayed quiet for years because she knew exactly what would happen if she spoke up.

She was right. No outrage. No soul-searching. No demands for accountability. Just silence.

That's the part that should chill you: the women inside the movement know they won't be protected either. They know proximity to power is not protection. They know the men who call them "one of the good ones" will turn on them the second they become inconvenient.

And yet Tate's orbit reaches all the way into Trump's inner circle -- close enough, reportedly, to the president's own son. I'm a father to a 7-year-old boy. I would not let Andrew Tate anywhere near him. Not for a conversation. Not for advice. Not for a joke. Not for a second. In Trump world, it wasn't disqualifying. It was access. And that tells you exactly what their version of "protecting children" actually means. They protect themselves. They protect the movement. Everyone else is disposable.

Then there's the Epstein files -- evidence of the abuse of young girls and boys that the Republican Party is working overtime to keep buried.

I know this isn't new. The examples of Republican politicians abusing women -- up to and including Donald Trump -- could fill a book. But it's hitting me hard right now because these are the same men currently campaigning on their manliness. They're out there telling you James Talarico is gay, that Josh Turek isn't a real man. They come after me -- a member of White Dudes for Harris -- and call me a cuck.

It's ridiculous. There is nothing masculine about men who hurt the women in their lives, excuse the men who do, and then demand applause for being protectors. This is why I want to retire the term "toxic masculinity" -- because nothing these guys do is masculine. They are weak-willed, violent, angry haters who want to suppress women, and they are incapable of anything but cruelty. They worship the image of strength while excusing the violence and abuse of the actual men leading their movement. They care more about looking masculine than being decent.

No new ideas. Just grievance and hate. And I am so tired of it.

And before anyone rushes to the comments with Graham Platner: yes. That accusation is out there, it's credible, and I've said so several times. I'm not pretending it's a nothing burger, because I don't believe it is. Being on my side of the aisle doesn't earn anyone a free pass. There are scumbags in both parties, and we should root them out wherever we find them. But we do a phenomenally better job policing our own.

What we're looking at is an entire movement of men in MAGA who do nothing to protect and provide for anyone -- certainly not the women and children in their lives. That is the rot at the core of what that party has become. And it's why we have to do everything we can to get them out of power.

They campaign as protectors and providers. They protect no one but themselves.

Peter,

**I just won the Minnesota GOP endorsement for the U.S. Senate — but I’m not celebrating. **

Because while we were earning the trust of Republican delegates in Duluth, the radical left was doubling down on the same insanity that’s destroying our state.

_**Take a look at this:**_

_[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=58172e459bb043e2b819fec926e1daf1&_e=fxGsavSLbo_YT_qDFK7z5BhnS2PthvduF0RkMSgTAbXvTIRyfa-0u8Vnev0RW5uQTmQFek2LabGsic58dZdLFQ9liUSilMEaoM9jz5HQlwbA-bWzeSEi9KJFfwbe3sP2m2-EzTEqImbNSbXJfHRyH_WeaQ0x3X0_esaCD8O_Q32-faLwLD-Ol56IezQVUzwB9JRhmLVJ0BWHG3DuEX7OeraHqqvq5CgNSLj5As0dNekWKYuG3M_jdio6Y9byNpdehiC8CT_Rko9dmKyNmVWv7mFPqUzpCNYxzMNHCu8_b2-0vl_HJzvjMfxdSKkkgXxQ-Tzilez5nNwdX1eB3tDO4whISXunrKbY8Zuk9tde5cWEy41HsPOtzHPo5qGdXUjpg6gNJqvYTIfWbJYQEn3uFz9FobXHr5YuzZFEdZPJ7MgXeVkythmX_C_8-T05_Z7vHtsULql6neNVdHgBSqMMJ8ZnfCV1LuCRVoKHb-Dq1w6i-qbonJ0VWXvpN9sJE8HxmtltWgVxLrN2SdKOlawW4c5gAs09dcrIlBhQfvh7y5UoSqtytd7cgANWKtaUU4Ik0a1Il076Iw776ep6BFuZN2A9oZNCYkWkjWLdI2Im6QOUPS-nHju2-7TunZzQbUgaKoY1Dmsfodi4IdFVtLaXu9SzPIvJbznZ9JaqdtMoyG89qSmP4k49qAUI1ZNSzXDNGJJkVadICZtav-tOmrsY59O5ZRf1onJo08GyASnDRU5poDFbcEItLWX2Vv33AU6q)_
This is Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan — Tim Walz’s **insane 2nd-in-command** , and the person standing between Minnesota and real leadership in the U.S. Senate.

_**She’s been cosplaying as a Somali Muslim.**_****

This isn’t leadership. It’s cynical cultural appropriation — the same tired game we’ve seen from the far left for years. And it shows exactly how out of touch these radicals have become with real Minnesotans.
981925
As we approach America’s 250th anniversary, I keep asking myself:_**Is this the legacy we want to leave our children?**_

**I didn’t enter this fight to play games. On my 18th birthday, weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and fought in the Battle of Najaf. I later became a Navy SEAL and deployed nine times across the globe. I’ve seen what happens when leaders put ideology over duty.**

That same sense of duty brought me home to Minnesota._**I watched Tim Walz abandon Minneapolis while riots raged — even near my own sister’s home.**_ I saw our police defunded, our streets burned, and hardworking families crushed under higher taxes and radical policies.

[**STOP THE FAR LEFT AGENDA
**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=58172e459bb043e2b819fec926e1daf1&_e=fxGsavSLbo_YT_qDFK7z5BhnS2PthvduF0RkMSgTAbXvTIRyfa-0u8Vnev0RW5uQTmQFek2LabGsic58dZdLFQ9liUSilMEaoM9jz5HQlwbA-bWzeSEi9KJFfwbe3sP2m2-EzTEqImbNSbXJfHRyH_WeaQ0x3X0_esaCD8O_Q32-faLwLD-Ol56IezQVUzwB9JRhmLVJ0BWHG3DuEX7OeraHqqvq5CgNSLj5As0dNekWKYuG3M_jdio6Y9byNpdehiC8CT_Rko9dmKyNmVWv7hMnhcvYGA4z0z3BehcSZ14NrMxHf8WruTkCBijjwzrD0mlCRhpCoOtaKqxNPXebHaslNpG0GCr112KNLrHtCCUH-Oa7jp0VESguAsrgIrS8cTh5CUGFUsmEl2H98XClFtDPPmYx9FaNbuIaPeENMlzDBGvkAAn4rOCyt6Ck6xZSjPfrrC_Cq1EAtDAY-HcXylJDTP6MWueaVD1xqd0PWR5uaIjiFf1oCoWzPB12ZSgD_lNE_y_qUuQzMnW3TZENBJcnSbHVpSmeHSBNT6WTxNxajR037rJyXB6q3BkmyMpwn6mnBwK1oaSMdjYnwmCfIJqEwFkTcH47WoMmyhkD26q6wiAgfCND9RyM_oxdMor3CApcCy6PARy-0c8rBUgKIhC4g7jpLI11nPlZOy_s7FfGC-YZx7pQ4Ez9Pins1T6AoDdwI3d1m2AXJN_Dp47vtrVAdlosmrAYzNrp7BCi6kWrUx6R14TQJhkUZZuDU4cX)

_**Now the real battle begins.**_

**Peggy Flanagan and the Walz machine represent the worst of the modern Democratic Party:** covering up fraud, open borders, boys in girls’ sports, attacks on law enforcement, and a growing pro-Hamas radicalism that rejects everything our Founding Fathers stood for.

I’m not a career politician. I’m a combat veteran, a Christian, and a proud working-class Minnesotan who still believes in secure borders, safe communities, and the American Dream.

Because while we were earning the trust of Republican delegates in Duluth, the radical left was doubling down on the same insanity that’s destroying our state. Take a look at this: This is Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan — Tim Walz’s insane 2nd-in-command , and the person standing between Minnesota and real leadership in the U.S. Senate. She’s been cosplaying as a Somali Muslim.** This isn’t leadership. It’s cynical cultural appropriation — the same tired game we’ve seen from the far left for years. And it shows exactly how out of touch these radicals have become with real Minnesotans. 981925 As we approach America’s 250th anniversary, I keep asking myself:Is this the legacy we want to leave our children? I didn’t enter this fight to play games. On my 18th birthday, weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and fought in the Battle of Najaf. I later became a Navy SEAL and deployed nine times across the globe. I’ve seen what happens when leaders put ideology over duty. That same sense of duty brought me home to Minnesota.I watched Tim Walz abandon Minneapolis while riots raged — even near my own sister’s home. I saw our police defunded, our streets burned, and hardworking families crushed under higher taxes and radical policies. That’s why I spent the last year grinding across this state — going to local events, listening to real people, and earning the Republican Party’s endorsement the right way. Now the real battle begins. Peggy Flanagan and the Walz machine represent the worst of the modern Democratic Party: covering up fraud, open borders, boys in girls’ sports, attacks on law enforcement, and a growing pro-Hamas radicalism that rejects everything our Founding Fathers stood for. I’m not a career politician. I’m a combat veteran, a Christian, and a proud working-class Minnesotan who still believes in secure borders, safe communities, and the American Dream. Peter, I can’t win this alone. I’m not asking for the kind of sacrifice I made on nine deployments. I’m simply asking you to join the fight as a patriot. Thank you for your support as we defend the values that made this state and this country great — especially with America’s 250th birthday on the horizon. We are just days away from the June 2nd election, and I want to encourage everyone to make a plan to vote. I’m running for Governor because too many Californians are being pushed out by rising costs and a lack of leadership focused on everyday people. I also want to expand down payment assistance for first-time homebuyers, support small businesses, create good paying jobs, increase access to childcare and education, and hold large corporations accountable for driving up costs.

Peter,
New York’s voter registration deadline is in two days, and we only have a short window left to reach as many unregistered voters as possible.
[**If you want to help power this final push, will you rush a donation of $3 or any amount to support Voto Latino’s voter registration work in New York?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260611-1-ak.I7ob9c&amount=3&refcode=em20260611-240&t=1&akid=240%2E1366028%2EdhKqC9)
We’re going all in on the districts where Latino voters can be the margin of victory and where flipping a seat could help decide control of the U.S. House. **One of the clearest opportunities is New York’s 17th Congressional District, where Latino voters make up about 20% of the district.**
Right now, NY-17 is represented by**Republican Congressman Mike Lawler** , and despite being in a “purple" district, he’s voted with Trump 100% of the time.
He’s also backed cuts to Medicaid and food assistance that would impact New York families, and voted for policies that would cut billions from New York hospitals, including facilities already under serious financial strain.

name: Aaron Ford
subject: We just won
body:
I’m honored to be your Democratic nominee for Nevada governor.
#
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260611_partner_ms_ford_em_leftnet._OT8L2&refcode=em20260611-1656&amount=5&t=1&akid=1656%2E2118727%2EhFQ0z9)
Friends,
This week, Nevada Democrats made me their nominee for governor.
I want to be honest with you about what I'm feeling right now:**grateful, fired up, and ready to work.**
**[If you’re ready to flip Nevada blue this November, then I’m humbly asking you to make a donation to our campaign today. This is a toss-up race, and we’re going to need every bit of support to win.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260611_partner_ms_ford_em_leftnet._OT8L2&refcode=em20260611-1656&amount=5&t=2&akid=1656%2E2118727%2EhFQ0z9)**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260611_partner_ms_ford_em_leftnet._OT8L2&refcode=em20260611-1656&amount=5&t=3&akid=1656%2E2118727%2EhFQ0z9)**
This is a campaign for the entirety of the Nevada family. Here’s what I mean by that:
**No one should have to struggle to find a good-paying job, pay their bills, afford healthcare, or raise a family in our state — but under the Lombardo-Trump economy, Nevadans are worse _off_ than they were years before.**
We need someone in the governor’s office who knows what it’s like to rely on food stamps, WIC, and Medicaid.
We also need someone who won’t turn their backs on working people to please mega corporations and Donald Trump.
I’ve lived through that struggle and know how important it is for people to have a government that truly invests in them — and I promise you, I’ll never forget that.
But we won’t win this race on values alone. The MAGA money machine is already working overtime to protect Governor Joe Lombardo, and the only way we’ll compete with their mutli-million dollar war chest is if we band together.
The latest polling shows I’m statistically tied with Lombardo. **This race is winnable, but it can easily slip away from us if we sit back and wait.**
[**So please, make a $5 contribution now to our campaign, to help us flip Nevada blue:**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260611_partner_ms_ford_em_leftnet._OT8L2&refcode=em20260611-1656&amount=5&t=4&akid=1656%2E2118727%2EhFQ0z9)
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260611_partner_ms_ford_em_leftnet._OT8L2&refcode=em20260611-1656&amount=5&t=5&akid=1656%2E2118727%2EhFQ0z9)**
Thanks so much,
Aaron

name: Aaron Ford
subject: Breaking news: We won!
body:
I’m honored to be your Democratic nominee for Nevada governor.
Peter,
Tuesday, Nevada Democrats made me their nominee for governor.
I want to be honest with you about what I'm feeling right now: **grateful, fired up, and ready to work.**
**[If you’re ready to flip Nevada blue this November, then I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between Wes Moore and our campaign today. This is a toss-up race, and we’re going to need every bit of support to win.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260611-1.CZdcpN&refcode=em-20260611-1&t=1&akid=1485%2E1086043%2EJt_iWE)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260611-1.CZdcpN&amount=5&refcode=em-20260611-1&t=20&akid=1485%2E1086043%2EJt_iWE)**
Peter, this is a campaign for the entirety of the Nevada family. Here’s what I mean by that:
**No one should have to struggle to find a good-paying job, pay their bills, afford healthcare, or raise a family in our state — but under the Lombardo-Trump economy, Nevadans are _worse off_ than they were years before.**
We need someone in the governor’s office who knows what it’s like to rely on food stamps, WIC, and Medicaid.
We also need someone who won’t turn their backs on working people to please mega corporations and Donald Trump.
Peter, I’ve lived through that struggle and know how important it is for people to have a government that truly invests in them — and I promise you, I’ll never forget that.
But we won’t win this race on values alone. The MAGA money machine is already working overtime to protect Governor Joe Lombardo, and the only way we’ll compete with their mutli-million dollar war chest is if we band together.
The latest polling shows I’m statistically tied with Lombardo. **This race is winnable, but it can easily slip away from us if we sit back and wait.**
**[So please, make a $5 contribution now, split between Wes Moore and our campaign, to help us flip Nevada blue:](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260611-1.CZdcpN&refcode=em-20260611-1&t=21&akid=1485%2E1086043%2EJt_iWE)**

Thanks so much,
Aaron

clean_body: I’m honored to be your Democratic nominee for Nevada governor. Peter, Tuesday, Nevada Democrats made me their nominee for governor. I want to be honest with you about what I'm feeling right now: grateful, fired up, and ready to work. Peter, this is a campaign for the entirety of the Nevada family. Here’s what I mean by that: No one should have to struggle to find a good-paying job, pay their bills, afford healthcare, or raise a family in our state — but under the Lombardo-Trump economy, Nevadans are worse off than they were years before. We need someone in the governor’s office who knows what it’s like to rely on food stamps, WIC, and Medicaid. We also need someone who won’t turn their backs on working people to please mega corporations and Donald Trump. Peter, I’ve lived through that struggle and know how important it is for people to have a government that truly invests in them — and I promise you, I’ll never forget that. But we won’t win this race on values alone. The MAGA money machine is already working overtime to protect Governor Joe Lombardo, and the only way we’ll compete with their mutli-million dollar war chest is if we band together. The latest polling shows I’m statistically tied with Lombardo. This race is winnable, but it can easily slip away from us if we sit back and wait. Thanks so much, Aaron

### **Virginia Parents Speak Out Over Loudoun County Transgender School Policies**
Loudoun County parents **[are pushing back against transgender policies](https://substack.com/redirect/f4af4871-9f47-46b8-a31f-3f3046772ab6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in their local public schools following the Capitol Hill hearing this week where district Superintendent Spence testified that transgender women should be permitted in women's spaces. The hearing also drew school officials from Chicago and San Francisco, all fielding questions from Congress about whether biological males should access facilities designated for girls.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4af4871-9f47-46b8-a31f-3f3046772ab6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Mother Abbie Platt told Fox News she feels compelled to speak out** on behalf of the more than 70,000 students in the district, noting that many parents fear professional retaliation for voicing concerns. She says her children have been subjected to several issues concerning the school's transgender policies, including an incident where her son experienced a biological female classmate entering the boys' bathroom while he was using it.
* **Father Seth Wolfe said he was deeply unsatisfied with school officials ' congressional testimony,** arguing that existing policies compromise student safety rather than prioritize education. He contends the situation has deteriorated over five years. With local private schools at capacity, many families feel they have no viable alternative to the public school system.

# **Trump Calls Off Iran Strikes, Says Deal Is "All Wrapped Up"**
President Donald Trump **[abruptly canceled planned strikes on Iran](https://substack.com/redirect/6e857ffe-d8bb-42fb-a811-93ca4ed9824d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday evening, announcing on Truth Social that discussions with Tehran had reached the highest levels of Iranian leadership and been approved. Trump told the New York Post the agreement was "pretty much all wrapped up," with a formal signing ceremony to be announced. The deal reportedly involves Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for the US lifting its nearly two-month naval blockade of Iranian ports -- though the blockade will remain until the agreement is formally signed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e857ffe-d8bb-42fb-a811-93ca4ed9824d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The breakthrough came after a frantic day of escalating threats.** Just hours before canceling the strikes, Trump had vowed to hit Iran "very hard" and threatened to seize Kharg Island, which handles roughly 90% of Iran's crude oil exports. Overnight US strikes had targeted Iranian missile systems, radar installations, and air defense sites along the coast.
* **Key questions remain unanswered.** Iran's state-linked media denied any agreement had been finalized, and a senior Israeli official said Israel was unaware of any deal. Qatar and Pakistan have been the primary intermediaries facilitating communications between Washington and Tehran throughout negotiations.

I want you to hear Donald Trump in his own words. When a reporter asked him about new data showing inflation at a three-year high — groceries up, rent up, families stretched to the breaking point — he said: "I love the inflation." Not "I'm working on it." Not "I feel your pain." He loves it. This is the same man who told reporters last month, "I don't think about Americans' financial situation" as his war in Iran increases gas prices. **At least he's honest about one thing: He doesn't think about you. He never has.** And it doesn't stop there. On election night in 2024, Trump stood on stage and promised the American people: "I'm not going to start a war. I'm going to stop wars." Three months into his war with Iran, he said in an interview — with a straight face — "When you say I promised, I didn't promise anything." He promised. And now he's pretending he didn't. He also said we have “no money” to pay for child care or health care. But his government was able to conveniently find $1.776 BILLION to set up a compensation fund to support January 6th insurrectionists. But should we be surprised? This is the man who built his political comeback on the Big Lie — telling Americans over and over that an election he lost was stolen. No matter how many courts, recounts, and members of his own administration said otherwise. Lying isn't a side effect with Donald Trump. It's the whole strategy. **I’m done being surprised at their hypocrisy, but I’m not done fighting back.** We don't have to take this. In November, voters will decide whether he gets a rubber-stamp Congress for two more years of this — or whether we put a check on his power. The path to victory is simple: We must expose every lie, every deception, and remind working people of the truth they already feel — Trump never had their best interests in mind, and he will always, always put himself first. But not only that, Democrats need to give voters something to vote FOR instead of just being “not Trump.” That’s why I’m laser-focused on pushing our party to champion policies like universal child care, taxing the rich, and raising the minimum wage — no matter how much it may upset corporate donors. [**His strategy is to lie so often that we stop keeping track. We won’t give him the satisfaction. If you're able, will you pitch in $28 or any amount to power our campaign to expose the lies, take back Congress, and get our government to ACTUALLY work for working people?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3669?amount=28&t=8&akid=2927%2E4032634%2E24fbpw)

This is the same man who told reporters last month, "I don't think about Americans' financial situation" as his war in Iran increases gas prices. At least he's honest about one thing: He doesn't think about you. He never has. And it doesn't stop there. On election night in 2024, Trump stood on stage and promised the American people: "I'm not going to start a war. I'm going to stop wars." Three months into his war with Iran, he said in an interview — with a straight face — "When you say I promised, I didn't promise anything." He promised. And now he's pretending he didn't. He also said we have “no money” to pay for child care or health care. But his government was able to conveniently find $1.776 BILLION to set up a compensation fund to support January 6th insurrectionists. But should we be surprised? This is the man who built his political comeback on the Big Lie — telling Americans over and over that an election he lost was stolen. No matter how many courts, recounts, and members of his own administration said otherwise. Lying isn't a side effect with Donald Trump. It's the whole strategy. I’m done being surprised at their hypocrisy, but I’m not done fighting back. We don't have to take this. In November, voters will decide whether he gets a rubber-stamp Congress for two more years of this — or whether we put a check on his power. The path to victory is simple: We must expose every lie, every deception, and remind working people of the truth they already feel — Trump never had their best interests in mind, and he will always, always put himself first. But not only that, Democrats need to give voters something to vote FOR instead of just being “not Trump.” That’s why I’m laser-focused on pushing our party to champion policies like universal child care, taxing the rich, and raising the minimum wage — no matter how much it may upset corporate donors. # **[Trump threatened Iran strikes
then yanks it back like a pro](https://substack.com/redirect/c68661d7-9309-4bd9-b4ce-93808f417597?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I just tore through whats out there on **[Trump's Iran oil shakedown](https://substack.com/redirect/91deca19-b624-4b59-8814-ca3f881962f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. It's moving fast so read fast and trade faster. This is my no BS take on what im seeing right now.
The Don just went full resource acquisition mode. Threatens to bomb the hell out of Iran and **[seize their crown jewel Kharg Island](https://substack.com/redirect/774869c8-c2ea-4de5-b6f3-5c8088bd0184?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , (Iran's main oil export terminal that handles 90% of their crude) and take total control of their oil and gas markets exactly like we did successfully in Venezuela. He compared it directly, saying it worked brilliantly for everyone.
Then hours later he cancels the strikes claiming the mullahs approved high-level talks. Classic Trump, max pressure then pause for the deal. Iranian state media calls bullshit immediately but no one cared. The market is trading the headline, not the fine print and they loved it: stocks popped, **[Oil (Brent and WTI) got slammed](https://substack.com/redirect/4042151e-86e8-41bb-8d79-eabca5649a87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** nearly 3% and oil traders got whipsawed again. This is pure theater but the kind that prints money.
The real play here is recognizing that the Strait of Hormuz risk premium just got vaporized temporarily. The blockade stays, so Iran's exports are still strangled. Controlling Iranian oil infrastructure means redirecting flows to U.S. allies or our refineries, crushing their revenue while boosting ours. It's not war, it's a hostile takeover.
**Winners?** U.S. energy firms, American energy dominance, our strategic reserves, refiners and downstream players getting cheaper oil, anyone long volatility or short crude futures on the fakeout and any company positioned in Gulf logistics or alternative routes.
**Losers?** Iran loses big. Their regime is bleeding cash, their economy is already gasping. The mullahs know their navy and air defenses are toast. Any weak hands who bought the war premium probably feel like an Iranian radar operator right now. Everyones having a good time except you. Upstream producers who were banking on sustained high prices will be along to join you at the bar to drown their sorrows shortly.
**Next?** Either Iran signs a humiliating deal fast or Trump hits harder and follows through on the seizure. Either way, American leverage is massive. Chaos is opportunity on steroids. Markets are forward-looking so expect more swings. Smart money is positioning for more volatility because Trump loves this dance. Buy the dip if you're bullish on long-term disruption or hedge like hell.
We're not nation-building, we're asset-grabbing. We're playing for keeps in the great energy game. This is how you dominate and why power matters in commodities. Weakness gets you nothing; strength gets you the assets.
Load up on positions that benefit from Pax Americana enforcing the rules cuz this isn't diplomacy, it's deal-making with bombs as leverage. Beautiful.

# [Oppenheimer's rocket-fueled price target lights the fuse on SpaceX](https://substack.com/redirect/c68661d7-9309-4bd9-b4ce-93808f417597?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

That's screaming 40% upside from the $135 IPO price, valuing this beast at $2.5 trillion. These guys see SpaceX as the only vertically integrated AI monster with satellites, chips, manufacturing, and the balls to dominate a $10 trillion market by 2035. Orbital data centers? Starship launching 27 times a day? That's not science fiction, thats a Death Star sized money printer if they are right. They've already locked in $26 billion in annualized data center deals with Anthropic and Google. Sure, there are risks, Musk key-man bullshit, unproven space tech, thermal issues in orbit, that tiny float guaranteeing volatility and as Bezos found out, rockets are expensive when they go boom.
**Winners?** Early bagholders and anyone riding the space-AI convergence.
**Losers?** Anyone still betting against Elon and the rocket boys.
**Next?** Watch Starship commercial service this year or estimates get torched.
Small-float IPOs pop hard and run. This isn't some meme stock; it's infrastructure for the space based future. Buy the dip if it wobbles post-IPO.

# [Starlink is the real engine driving SpaceX to IPO glory](https://substack.com/redirect/c68661d7-9309-4bd9-b4ce-93808f417597?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Forget the flashy rockets for a second. **[Starlink is the cash cow](https://substack.com/redirect/3482b0b5-8977-4554-b72b-e7765b356888?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** making SpaceX's IPO the most anticipated ever. That satellite broadband beast hit 10.3 million subscribers and delivered $7.2 billion in adjusted EBITDA for the connectivity segment last year, up 86%. The company lost money overall on AI bets, but Starlink is the profit machine vertically integrated from satellites to ground dishes. Low latency, global coverage, no competition worth a damn yet. (Amazon's Project Kuiper is still crawling and as we know, it doesn't look like Blue Origin will be putting anything in space for a while after their Cape Canaveral firework show.) This isn't just internet; it's the backbone for data, government contracts, aviation, and future space infrastructure. Analysts know the SpaceX story is really the Starlink story. At a $1.77 trillion valuation, investors are buying into this orbital network dominating broadband where fiber can't reach.
**Winners?** SpaceX shareholders cashing in on recurring revenue growth, Starlink customers finally getting reliable internet in dead zones, and the entire space economy.
**Losers?** Traditional telecoms watching their rural markets evaporate and any competitor trying to catch up.
**Next?** Massive subscriber adds, more constellations, integration with AI orbital data centers.
This IPO is your ticket to own a piece of the future of connectivity. Don't chase hype focus on the revenue reality Starlink delivers. Position aggressively.

ARK took a beating when rates spiked and her funds bled, but this is vindication for the high-conviction, high-volatility bet. **Winners?** ARK investors who stuck around and ignored the jeers and anyone long on Musk's ecosystem.
**Losers?** The shorts who doubted her again and the traditional value guys still sleeping on this.
**Next?** Cathie's style is either genius or reckless, but with SpaceX printing money via Starlink and data centers, her conviction looks brilliant right now. Watch her funds surge on the debut.
If you're not paying attention to where the growth queen is parking capital, you're playing small ball. Load up on the names she loves before they gap higher, just be ready for the haters who are going to hate.

# [SpaceX IPO mints millionaires ready to blow cash on mansions and jets](https://substack.com/redirect/c68661d7-9309-4bd9-b4ce-93808f417597?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**[The SpaceX IPO is about to create](https://substack.com/redirect/a8faa003-24cc-4ca8-8dcb-c8d3c438b86c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** thousands of new millionaires and a handful of billionaires among SpaceX employees, and they're already mapping out their spending sprees. Luxury real estate in South Bay California and Austin Texas is ground zero. These rocket nerds in their 30s and 40s are eyeing oceanfront pads in Manhattan Beach and ranches outside Austin to park Ferraris in four-car garages. Real estate agents are getting calls from guys in disbelief about buying homes for their parents with all this new discretionary income. Watches? Rolex Daytonas and Submariners are flying off shelves as the first status symbol reminder of their big score. Private jets to Vegas, Miami, Cabo for celebrations. This wealth transfer is going to juice luxury markets hard, just like Facebook's IPO did for those neighborhoods.
**Winners:** Luxury brokers, watch dealers, jet charter companies, and the local economies around SpaceX hubs.
**Losers:** Anyone selling to these guys too early before the lockup ends.
**Next?** The spending wave is coming. Smart money positions in high-end real estate plays and consumer luxury stocks before these newly rich flood the market.
This is gonna be Wolf of Wall Street but with Rockets. Gulfstreams all the way, and screw the wealth manager trying to get you to cancel.

name: Rev. Raphael Warnock
subject: There is an extreme movement that will stop at nothing to silence your voice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
We must fight back.
| | |
---
Friend,
After the recent decision by Donald Trump and JD Vance’s Supreme Court to gut the Voting Rights Act, I’ve been reflecting on the full-scale assault that’s being waged on our rights and freedoms. On American democracy itself.
There is an extreme movement in this country that will stop at _nothing_ to hold on to power, even if it means stripping representation away from millions. Even if it means dragging us back to the dark and ugly days of Jim Crow.
Courts are blocking maps voted on and passed by the people – all while protecting maps drawn by politicians to dilute Black voices. Trump, Vance, and their allies are raiding election centers here in Georgia, threatening to deploy ICE to polling places, and attacking your ability to vote by mail.
**The people are being squeezed out of our democracy in real time. We cannot and we will not sit back and let it happen. The fight must continue.**
That’s why I’m counting on you to take action today and sign my brand-new petition to protect voting rights. **[Please, if you’re with me, will you add your name now to condemn Trump and Vance’s assault on American democracy and protect the right to vote?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133165128/626935457/-1018545112?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&code=jtk5626-su-nd&refcode=jtk5626-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjkyMzcyNi1lNTY1LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tSqzNc1bbZr6O7ydzL4QN7VgpL97QANrnUs9onGpo7U=&emci=095a9659-f764-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=5f923726-e565-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=1586379)**

But against all odds, I’m here – and it’s important you understand _how_ I got here.** This email is long, so if you don’t have a spare minute to read this all the way through, [**_please consider chipping in a few bucks before midnight – so I can keep fighting for all of us in Congress. >>_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/3BpyWwS7hOeMK5PEOdkMtw~~/AAPPABA~/sHzax5vfklDfzCyBspL3njz8tF_ts7XoHFaMhuXLEKZ7kL4huBwLQ2PO_SUiZlfBVvNqA4cVCzYAjPqXfgKfpq6VWW5-D7lRO9zcmI9NSrU-j2k_hx2ufhPkE1w2uCylR-HoxMFFGvlDRhGoj4-V1vRmBflWePbHbqkgpT9pOJ3jeN3Js0Z2LfkWiRGNiRO17nmnm4YXPwk9s-O9NZZjzN2sd-h3bq0AnbO3kNSpk_AZ2YmiZo1Q-8wLjcM1-b58sRtuouGkfpAi7IWNGFSb01AFLqPowvcf39_x6kzjkRiIiKjMaKkppGSgK-MtwGGTCaHN8hp59XbwP99p1iucGm1jEWJ8cN1onGAWc6jsF2I~) I was raised in a working-class family. My parents struggled through more broken systems – from underfunded schools, to outrageous healthcare costs, to juggling different jobs to pay the bills. Even when I grew up and ran for Congress, I was a Gen Z working class kid – I didn’t have the same advantages that other candidates have. I drove for Uber and racked up credit card debt just to make ends meet during my campaign. Because of that, everyone counted me out. **But I was able to defy the odds: by becoming a community leader, the National Organizing Director for March for our Lives, and the first member of Gen Z elected to Congress.** _Now, I need you to help me defy the odds once again to**stay** in Congress._ I’m determined to keep fighting for working-class folks, but I can’t do that without your grassroots support. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. I’m honored to be your Democratic nominee for Nevada governor.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=partner-ms-ford-em-hinojosa.NLkUyN&refcode=em20260611-1306&amount=5&t=1&akid=1306%2E299639%2EcTYeRt)
Peter,
This week, Nevada Democrats made me their nominee for governor.
I want to be honest with you about what I'm feeling right now:**grateful, fired up, and ready to work.**
**[If you’re ready to flip Nevada blue this November, then I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between Gina Hinojosa and our campaign today. This is a toss-up race, and we’re going to need every bit of support to win.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=partner-ms-ford-em-hinojosa.NLkUyN&refcode=em20260611-1306&amount=5&t=2&akid=1306%2E299639%2EcTYeRt)**

Peter, this is a campaign for the entirety of the Nevada family. Here’s what I mean by that:
No one should have to struggle to find a good-paying job, pay their bills, afford healthcare, or raise a family in our state — but under the Lombardo-Trump economy, Nevadans are worse off than they were years before.
We need someone in the governor’s office who knows what it’s like to rely on food stamps, WIC, and Medicaid.
We also need someone who won’t turn their backs on working people to please mega corporations and Donald Trump.
Peter, I’ve lived through that struggle and know how important it is for people to have a government that truly invests in them — and I promise you, I’ll never forget that.
But we won’t win this race on values alone. The MAGA money machine is already working overtime to protect Governor Joe Lombardo, and the only way we’ll compete with their mutli-million dollar war chest is if we band together.
The latest polling shows I’m statistically tied with Lombardo. **This race is winnable, but it can easily slip away from us if we sit back and wait.**
[**So please, make a $5 contribution now, split between Gina's and our campaign, to help us flip Nevada blue:**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=partner-ms-ford-em-hinojosa.NLkUyN&refcode=em20260611-1306&amount=5&t=22&akid=1306%2E299639%2EcTYeRt)

Aaron

Peter,
I’m proud to share that a new election law was passed here in Colorado—legislation that my office helped champion and worked with the legislature to pass to further strengthen and protect Colorado’s gold-standard election system.
At a moment when Trump and MAGA extremists are attacking voting rights and spreading conspiracy theories, we are moving in the opposite direction: protecting voters and reinforcing elections against potential disruptions and political interference from the Trump administration.
This new law makes important improvements to Colorado’s elections. The new law:
* Requires ballots be sent earlier and drop boxes to open earlier, starting with the general election this fall
* Strengthens the prohibition on voter interference
* Prevents candidates seeking a third term of the Presidency from appearing on Colorado ballots
The law also strengthens election administration and helps ensure Colorado remains a national model for secure, accessible, and fair elections.
I’ve spent years defending Colorado’s elections from lies and attacks by extremists who want to undermine democracy.
As Attorney General, I’ll continue fighting to protect voting rights, defend the rule of law, and stop anyone who tries to interfere with Coloradans’ right to vote. If you’re with me in this fight, chip in today to help us keep defending democracy in Colorado. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2606-q2-jg]

name: Tim Moore
subject: Your Kid. Their Agenda.
disclaimer_text: paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
body:
Peter, from the moment your child was born, you've fought for them.

You chose their school.

You knew their teachers.

You shaped what they believed about this country, about right and wrong, about who they are.

Somewhere along the way, Washington decided that was too much power for a parent to have.

Now school's out for summer — but the bureaucrats are already planning what goes back in the classroom this fall. And they're counting on you to enjoy the break and stop paying attention.

Well, I'm counting on you to prove them wrong. So I need you to answer one question: WHO should have the final say in what your child is taught — YOU, or an unelected bureaucrat? [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/061126_education_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.11.26_Education_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

I STAND WITH PARENTS [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/061126_education_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.11.26_Education_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

Across this country, parents are watching their kids come home with ideas they never agreed to teach them.

That America is something to be ashamed of.

That truth is whatever the government says it is.

And when moms and dads showed up to school board meetings to push back — they got labeled extremists.

YOU pay for those schools. YOU are responsible for that child's future. But they've cut you out of the conversation entirely.

Peter, you can’t back down. Your child’s future depends on it. Please, take our survey today and let me know who has the final say. [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/061126_education_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.11.26_Education_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

TAKE BACK THE CLASSROOM [https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-tim-moore/061126_education_samoore/?utm_source=Housefile&utm_medium=SA-Email&utm_campaign=06.11.26_Education_SAMoore&utm_content=Link&recurring=true]

Fighting for American families,

Congressman Tim Moore

North Carolina’s 14th District

body:

# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260611-2907)
Peter,
We’re four points away from closing the gap.
New polling leaked today shows that in the last two months, we’ve gained momentum. Thanks to my opponent, who leaked this poll, everyone now knows that our campaign has jumped up by eight points. We’re **just FOUR points from first place.** With a margin of error of ... 4 points 👀
Just _four points_ away—we can close that gap. We have an incredible community of supporters, we’ve led in the last several independent polls, and now our opponents are admitting it, too. Just four points? That means that everything counts, everything matters.
What can you do to help me close the gap? Knock doors, distribute yard signs, get involved in the movement, and contribute so we can compete against the dark money being thrown into this race. This weekend we have a [rally at Atwood music hall](https://act.francescahong.com/go/11142?t=1&akid=2907%2E105371%2EXqz4Vf), and then next weekend we have our first [**Statewide Weekend of Action**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13828?t=2&akid=2907%2E105371%2EXqz4Vf) where we’ll be knocking doors from Kenosha to Superior.
All of it helps close the gap.
Our biggest, and only reporting deadline is coming up at the end of June. [If all of you contributed $10 today, I could close ](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260609.ZSgolm&refcode=em20260611-2907&t=3&akid=2907%2E105371%2EXqz4Vf)[_that_ gap, too. ](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260609.ZSgolm&refcode=em20260611-2907&t=4&akid=2907%2E105371%2EXqz4Vf)
At least two of my opponents are backed by dark money groups ([neither even bothered to register as SuperPACs](https://act.francescahong.com/go/13829?t=5&akid=2907%2E105371%2EXqz4Vf), that's how _dark_ the money is) and they think they can buy this election.
All of that, and our people-powered movement is still winning.
I’m so grateful for all of you who’ve shown up and spent your extra time and money to help move this campaign forward. We couldn’t close the gap without you.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260609.ZSgolm&amount=5&refcode=em20260611-2907&t=8&akid=2907%2E105371%2EXqz4Vf)**
Thank you for being part of this.
— Fran

Thanks to my opponent, who leaked this poll, everyone now knows that our campaign has jumped up by eight points. We’re just FOUR points from first place. We have an incredible community of supporters, we’ve led in the last several independent polls, and now our opponents are admitting it, too. Just four points? That means that everything counts, everything matters. What can you do to help me close the gap? Knock doors, distribute yard signs, get involved in the movement, and contribute so we can compete against the dark money being thrown into this race. This weekend we have a , and then next weekend we have our first where we’ll be knocking doors from Kenosha to Superior. All of it helps close the gap. Our biggest, and only reporting deadline is coming up at the end of June. At least two of my opponents are backed by dark money groups (, that's how dark the money is) and they think they can buy this election. All of that, and our people-powered movement is still winning. I’m so grateful for all of you who’ve shown up and spent your extra time and money to help move this campaign forward. We couldn’t close the gap without you. My name is Mike Cortese. I'm running for Congress in Tennessee and want to share an opinion that might be a bit controversial to career politicians nowadays:
Our schools shouldn't be seen as just a talking point or a photo op. These institutions should be seen for what they are: actual human beings sitting in classrooms across Tennessee's 4th District every single day, trying to get an education in a system that has been underfunded, undermined, and politicized beyond recognition.
So, I'm running to make sure every child in Tennessee's 4th District and beyond receives a fully funded classroom, a supported teacher, and a real shot at the future. That is not a radical idea. It is the bare minimum. And I will fight for it every single day in Washington.
_**[If you agree with our mission, I'd be honored to have your support!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6762e386-f4f0-4833-ab23-19f21b023529?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8f7c1185-4354-4cb6-b822-c67f7e844517?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[CLICK HERE!!️](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6762e386-f4f0-4833-ab23-19f21b023529?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Teachers are leaving the profession in record numbers because they are asked to do everything and given nothing. Classrooms are overcrowded. School counselors are stretched impossibly thin. And the politicians who gutted public education funding are the same ones standing in front of cameras talking about the importance of family values.
Scott DesJarlais has been in Congress for 14 years. In that time, he has done nothing but vote against education funding while sending his own party's donors to profit from voucher programs that drain resources from the schools that need them most.
I have two boys of my own, and I know that as they grow, they'll need a proper education. I know what our families need because I'm no career politician, and my families are living through the exact same circumstances.
**Let 's make a difference, together. **_[Chip in $20 today and help us build a future worth showing up for.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6762e386-f4f0-4833-ab23-19f21b023529?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_

| | Friend,

Last month, I sat down with my friend W. Kamau Bell on his new podcast and made a lot of people mad.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133166592/626940368/-1625623082?refcode=cls-em-gotv-20260611-Kamaupod-365DO-img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDFiNDQzMDEtZWI2NS1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7_Ki1Gphw_2lSEqi2_p2feTwZXRJIlhLL0vRqFz5A6s=)
I told Kamau that there are more than 20 states in this country where women cannot access reproductive health care.

I said that it’s not enough for us to condemn the Trump court; we need to build underground railroads for abortion.

**Now _Breitbart_ , Libs of TikTok, and the rest of the right-wing outrage machine are calling on me to apologize.**

I won’t.

These attacks are intentional. They're designed to intimidate people out of talking about reproductive care in deep-red states. **But I haven’t gotten this far by staying quiet – _[will you chip in $5 today to support my advocacy?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133166593/626940369/-1625623082?refcode=cls-em-gotv-20260611-Kamaupod-365DO-l1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDFiNDQzMDEtZWI2NS1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7_Ki1Gphw_2lSEqi2_p2feTwZXRJIlhLL0vRqFz5A6s=)_**

Here’s why I’m not backing down.

I started my career as a teenager, organizing alongside young women on the streets of the Tenderloin, the Mission, and West Oakland – young women the system had failed, criminalized, and thrown away.

I learned then what I know now: When institutions refuse to protect people, we don’t wait. **We organize. We build networks of care. We get each other to safety.**

That’s what I said on Kamau’s podcast. It’s what I believe. And no c-tier Republican news outlet is going to bully me out of saying it.

Here’s what these outlets never want to cover: Right now, somewhere in this country, a woman is driving hundreds of miles across state lines for life-saving health care she cannot receive in her own neighborhood. If your daughter is raped and she lives in half of the states in this country, she will not have a choice but to carry the child of her rapist. **That is the real crisis that deserves headlines – not my comments on a podcast.**

If you couldn’t tell from the picture, I’ve been an Upstate New Yorker all my life and I wouldn’t have it any other way.

Between growing up here and raising a family of my own, I’ve got to say, Upstate New York is truly special.

| | **Yesterday, I voted no on the partisan bill to fund ICE, and I will continue to oppose funding ICE until the agency is required to follow the same rules as every other local, state, and federal law enforcement agency.** Congress has a responsibility to defend the American people from this lawlessness. Lawmakers on both sides of the aisle must unite in this effort and assert our constitutionally mandated congressional oversight authority to hold the Administration accountable. Fellow Patriot,

America turns 250 this July 4th.

I grew up all over Montana. Miles City. Helena. Dillon. Victor. Great Falls. July 4th looked a little different in each town but it always felt the same. We were proud. Not because someone told us to be. Just because we were.

My dad taught high school math. My mom taught elementary school. They were public servants their whole lives and they raised me to believe this country was worth showing up for.

_I still believe that._

I spent years as Montana's U.S. Attorney going after the cartels and criminals threatening families and communities. Now I am running for Senate because I think the next 250 years of this country are worth fighting for just as hard as the last.

Before July 4th, I want to ask you something. What does America mean to you?

[FLIP MICHIGAN RED](https://link.email.mikerogersforsenate.-Q/sbo7cc99dfc)

[**THIRD**](https://link.email.mikerogersforsenate.-Q/s7kfafad4fc), the Democrats are already running with their tail between their legs. Gary Peters, our incumbent Senator, decided he would rather quit his job than face me in a race he was sure he would lose.

\- Mike Rogers

Early money wins elections. This is an undeniable truth of campaigns. That's why we need your help today.
#
Peter, there’s an undeniable truth when it comes to political campaigns:
**Early money wins elections.**
Ads are cheaper when you book them early. Organizers need to get hired with enough time to effectively communicate with voters. Candidates build momentum when donors show up early to help build a strong infrastructure.
But here's the thing: We're already in June. Primaries are wrapping up. The general election battlefield is taking shape RIGHT NOW.
**The window to be an "early" donor – to get the most out of every dollar – is closing faster than you might think.**
**Republican super PACs have been reserving ad time for months.** Some of the biggest GOP groups have already committed to spending tens of millions of dollars in important races in places like Maine, Georgia, and Ohio.
_They didn't wait. And we can't either._
